description:
We are seeking a highly motivated, experienced Short-Term Rental Manager & Marketing specialist for our Vacation rental house in Fort Walton Beach, Florida.



We need someone who does more than simply manage reservations. We are looking for a **proactive, results-driven professional who will actively market our property, attract new guests, increase occupancy, and maximize rental revenue.**



The ideal candidate will treat our rental business as their own, taking initiative to identify opportunities, improve performance, and consistently generate new bookings.



 Key Responsibilities



**1. Marketing & Reservation Generation (Top Priority)**

- Develop and execute a marketing strategy focused on generating new reservations.

- Actively promote our vacation rentals through
, Instagram, TikTok, vacation rental groups, and other relevant platforms.

- Create engaging social media content, including posts, reels, promotional offers, and property highlights.

- Identify and engage with potential guests through relevant social media groups and online communities.

- Generate direct bookings to reduce reliance on third-party booking platforms.

- Develop promotions to fill vacant dates, last-minute cancellations, and slower seasons.

- Research local events, tourism trends, and seasonal opportunities to increase reservations.

- Track marketing performance and demonstrate measurable results.



**2. Listing & Revenue Management**

- Fully manage and optimize listings on Airbnb, Vrbo, and other relevant booking platforms.

- Improve listing descriptions, photos, keywords, and overall visibility.

- Monitor competitors and adjust pricing to remain competitive.

- Implement dynamic pricing strategies to maximize occupancy and revenue.

- Maintain accurate calendars and prevent double bookings.

- Identify opportunities to expand distribution and attract additional guests.



**3. Guest Communication & Experience**

- Handle all guest inquiries promptly and professionally.

- Manage the entire guest experience, from initial inquiry through checkout.

- Coordinate check-in instructions, checkout procedures, and guest support.

- Resolve guest complaints and issues efficiently.

- Encourage positive reviews and repeat bookings.

- Develop relationships with past guests to generate future reservations.



**4. Property Operations & Coordination**

- Coordinate cleaning services, inspections, maintenance, and repairs with local vendors.

- Ensure the property is guest-ready before every arrival.

- Monitor supply needs and coordinate replenishment.

- Handle unexpected guest or property issues.

- Communicate maintenance concerns and recommend improvements.

- Maintain high standards for property cleanliness, presentation, and guest satisfaction.



**5. Reporting & Accountability**

- Provide weekly updates detailing reservations, occupancy, revenue, and marketing activities.

- Track booking sources to determine which marketing strategies are producing results.

- Identify upcoming vacancies and develop proactive plans to fill them.

- Recommend improvements to increase revenue and reduce unnecessary expenses.

- Establish measurable performance goals and demonstrate consistent progress.



 Qualifications

- Proven experience managing Airbnb, Vrbo, or other vacation rental properties.

- **Strong experience in social media marketing and generating reservations, not just managing existing bookings.**

- Experience with direct booking strategies and online guest acquisition.

- Familiarity with dynamic pricing and vacation rental management software.

- Excellent written communication and customer service skills.

- Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of working independently.

- Comfortable coordinating with local cleaners, maintenance providers, and vendors.

- Experience managing Florida Gulf Coast vacation rentals is a plus.



We want someone who:

- Takes ownership of the property's success.

- Is creative and aggressive about generating new bookings.

- Understands how to market vacation rentals through social media.

- Consistently looks for ways to increase occupancy and profitability.

- Communicates proactively without requiring constant direction.

- Can demonstrate previous results growing vacation rental revenue.



**Our primary goal is simple: Increase reservations, maximize revenue, and have someone take full ownership of day-to-day management and marketing.**

ing

ing

title: SEO Manager – Full Time
description:
🏢 Company: Get Me Links

💵 Monthly Fee: USD $1,800–2,300 per month, depending on experience

🌍 Location: Fully remote

🕓 Hours: Full-time (flexible, but overlap with 1pm–10pm PH time required)



🎁 What You Get

Your monthly rate is only half the package. You'll also get:

  4 weeks of paid time off

  Performance bonuses tied to results

  A fully remote role: work from wherever you do your best work

  A full tool stack, with no fighting for the software you need

  A team ready to run the services you design, and the training to make that happen

  Close work with our Director of Service Operations

  A flexible schedule, no time tracking



💼 What You'll Be Doing

Get Me Links is an SEO and link-building agency that partners with digital marketing agencies, and we're building new services to grow beyond what we offer today. This is not a client SEO role: you won't run campaigns for individual clients. You'll own our off-page SEO operations and build the ones that don't exist yet, then keep them running well. You'll design new services, prove they work, turn them into processes a team can run, and maintain their quality over time. Link building is your core strength, and you bring a full understanding of SEO, so you can help build services across the whole picture.



Some examples of what we want to build:

  New types of link building beyond what we offer today

  Our own sites for link placement

  Buying expired and auction domains, then restoring them

  Link exchange programs run at scale



Your day-to-day:

  Build new services: find and design new SEO services we can sell and deliver

  Expand our offer: turn opportunities in Local SEO, GEO, AI visibility, listicles and Digital PR into services we can deliver at scale

  Grow the publisher network: build strong publisher relationships, negotiate prices, and run outreach at scale

  Protect link quality: set vetting standards that go beyond DR and traffic, and keep risky or spammy sites out of our network

  Shape link strategy: define best practice for anchor text mix, link velocity, relevance and target page selection

  Audit and analyze: run backlink audits and competitor link gap analysis to find new opportunities

  Apply the full SEO picture: work with our Director of Service Operations to bring on-page and technical knowledge (site speed, keyword targeting, site health) into how we vet sites and shape new services

  Set content standards: define briefs and quality bars for placement content, including how to spot low-quality AI content

  Systemize: turn each service into a repeatable process with SOPs and quality checks

  Train the people who run those services

  Maintain: monitor quality and results, fix what breaks, and update processes as SEO changes

  Measure: track links that stay live and get indexed, how long they last, and their impact on rankings and AI visibility

  Bring the outside in: share new SEO knowledge so the whole team grows past what we already know



🧬 Who You Are

An SEO manager who lives and breathes link building.

You look at a publisher site and immediately see the spam signals, the link farm footprints, or the traffic that isn't real, and you can explain why. You're savvy on how to get links that actually help: velocity, relevance, anchor text and the right tools. You also understand the full spectrum of SEO, so you know a slow site or poor keyword targeting can undermine a great link. You don't just run a playbook, you build one: you take a new idea, test it, prove it works, and turn it into a process a team can follow. You have strong opinions on SEO and can defend them, and you have the discipline to work within agreed standards once a decision is made. You keep up with algorithm changes because you want to.



✅ Requirements

  Deep, hands-on SEO experience, with real strength in off-page and link building

  A proven record of publisher outreach and relationship building at scale

  A sharp eye for link quality and risk: spam signals, link farms, Google spam policies, toxic links, disavow and penalty recovery

  Solid working knowledge of on-page and technical SEO (site speed, keyword targeting, site health), enough to judge site    quality and help shape new services

  Working knowledge across the wider SEO landscape: guest posts, niche edits and brand mentions, listicles, GEO, AI visibility,     Digital PR, Local SEO and backlink audits

  Experience with domain auctions, expired domain vetting and site restoration

  Hands-on skill with Ahrefs and Semrush, plus outreach tools such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream or Hunter

  Proof that you have built a service or process from scratch and kept it running well over time

  Experience leading or training a team

  Reliable internet and availability for the required overlap hours



🔥 Bonus Points If You…

Have an agency or link-selling background

Have experience with domain marketplaces and expired domain tools

Are comfortable with numbers: cost per link, margins and capacity planning



🎯 Your First 90 Days

In your first 90 days, you will:

  Learn our current services, publisher network and quality standards

  Audit our off-page processes and present your top improvement opportunities

  Propose at least one new service with a clear plan, cost model and SOP

  Launch that service as a pilot, with a team trained to run it



📝 How We'll Choose

We want to see the work, not just talk about it, so every applicant goes through the same steps:

1. Application + portfolio. For two or three services, processes or link projects you built, tell us what you made and what your role was, how it performed (links live, indexed, retention, rankings, margins), and what you learned and would do differently.

2. First interview with MJ, our Head of Operations. A conversation about your experience, how you vet link quality, your grasp of on-page and technical SEO basics, and how you turn an idea into a process a team can run.

3. Final interview with our CEO and COO. A deeper conversation on how you would build and pilot a new service, and how you work within agreed standards.



📬 How to Apply (Follow These Steps Precisely)

Please
 the following to 
 with the subject: "SEO Manager – I'm [Your Name] and I Build SEO Services That Scale"

Include:

   1. Your resume with two professional references

   2. Your portfolio, with results for two or three services, processes or link projects you built (what you made, how it performed, and what you learned)



Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed.

title: Experienced Real Estate Cold Caller / ISA – US Rural Land Acquisitions (Part-time / Full-time)
description:
ABOUT THE JOB

We buy rural land in the United States. You will make outbound phone calls to landowners from a dialer (BatchLeads Dialer), follow a written call script, tell interested owners our offer range, log every call, and book follow-up calls on my calendar. You do not negotiate and you do not sign anything. Your job is to be friendly, calm, and exact. Most owners are older, rural, and have never been called about their land, so a warm and patient voice matters.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Dial from our BatchLeads Dialer campaigns during the hours below.

- Follow the call script. Say our offer range word for word.

- Log the result of every call in our Google Sheet. Accurate logging is as important as the calls.

- Book follow-up calls with me on my Google Calendar when an owner is interested or gives a price.

- Leave a short voi
 when the SOP says to (live voice only).

- Keep our do-not-call list current. If an owner says "take me off your list", log it right away and never call them again.

- Send a short report at the end of each shift.



REQUIRED

- Real estate cold calling or ISA experience (US market preferred). Please tell us what you have called, for how long, and which dialers you used.

- Fluent, natural, conversational English. Owners must understand you easily on the phone at a normal speaking pace. We are not looking for a specific accent. We need clear speech, good listening, and a friendly tone. Your 2-minute voice recording is part of the application and we will listen to it carefully.

- Calm under rejection. Polite when someone is rude. You never argue.

- Strong attention to detail. You follow a written SOP exactly, and your call log is correct.

- Good headset with a microphone, a quiet room, and stable internet (wired or strong Wi-Fi) with a backup (mobile data or power bank). We will ask for a screenshot of a speed test.

- Experience with a power dialer or CRM (BatchLeads, BatchDialer, REI Reply, Mojo, PhoneBurner, Readymode, or similar). Google Sheets and Google Calendar skills.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with land or rural property owners.

- Experience in a US call center or as an appointment setter.



HOURS AND TIME ZONE

- You must be online and calling at least 4 hours a day inside 10:00 am - 7:00 pm US Central Time, Monday to Friday. (In winter that is about 12:00 midnight - 9:00 am Philippine time. In summer it is about 11:00 pm - 8:00 am. This is a night shift for you. Do not apply if you cannot do this.)

- Part-time: 20 hours per week to start, with a path to full-time (40 hours) after a strong first month. Best calling windows are 10 am - 1 pm and 4 pm - 7 pm Central.

- You call within legal hours only (8 am - 9 pm in the owner's local time). The SOP explains how.

- You must be reachable on WhatsApp during your shift.



PAY

- US$6 per hour, plus a US$10 bonus for each callback you book that I confirm was a real conversation with the property owner about selling. Paid weekly by Wise.

- US$500 flat bonus every time we close the purchase of a property where you had the first logged conversation with the owner. This is a fixed performance bonus for lead generation, not a commission or a share of any sale. It is paid after the purchase closes. Your call log is what ties a closed deal back to your call, so log every call.

- Pay review after 30 days if your calls and logging are accurate.

- Paid trial first (US$25 flat, about 90 minutes) for shortlisted applicants.



IMPORTANT RULES FOR THIS JOB (you will be trained)

- Calls are made by a real person only. No AI voices, no voice changers, no recorded messages, no ringless voi
. Ever.

- You never ask for or take bank details, SSN, or ID.

- You never handle money, contracts, or my
.

- You do not see all our data. You get a call sheet with only what you need.



HOW TO APPLY (IMPORTANT)

Start your application message with the word LAND as the very first word. Applications that do not do this will not be read.

Then do two things:



1. Answer these five questions in plain text:

   1) Your shift is inside 10:00 am - 7:00 pm US Central Time, which is night time in the Philippines (about midnight to 9:00 am in winter). Which exact hours can you work each day, and what is your plan if your internet or power goes down during a shift?

   2) Tell us about your cold calling experience: what industry, how long, which dialer(s) you used, about how many dials per hour, and what result you achieved (for example appointments set per week).

   3) An owner says "Please take me off your list." What exactly do you say, and what exactly do you do, step by step, after you hang up?

   4) Describe a time you made a mistake in repeated work (call logging, data entry, or CRM updates). How did you find it, and what did you change so it did not happen again?

   5) What is your hourly rate in USD, how many hours per week can you commit for the next 3 months, and what is your setup (headset model, internet speed in Mbps, backup internet)? Attach a screenshot of a speed test.



2. Attach or link a 2-minute voice recording (MP3, or a Google Drive / Vocaroo link). No recording means no review. Record yourself on your headset in a quiet room. Do not use any AI voice or voice changer. Do not edit. About 2 minutes total:

   - (30 seconds) Introduce yourself and your cold calling experience.

   - (45 seconds) Read this practice opener the way you would say it on a real call, using your own first name: "Hi, is this Mary? ... Hey Mary, my name is [Your First Name]. I'm not an agent, I buy land around here. I was looking at your twelve acres out on Smith Road, and I wondered, have you ever thought about selling it?"

   - (45 seconds) Answer out loud, as if on a call: an older owner says, "Who is this, and how did you get my number?" Say your reply in your own words.



Also write your expected rate in USD per hour, your time zone, and the hours you can work in US Central Time.

title: Multifamily Underwriting & Financial Modeling Tutor
description:
I'm a commercial real estate professional specializing in multifamily investment sales. I'm seeking a part-time private tutor to teach me multifamily underwriting and financial modeling the way it's taught in a university-level real estate development program — structured, rigorous, and built around a proper textbook curriculum.



This is a teaching engagement, not a one-off training session. I want someone who can guide me from fundamentals through a complete, self-built multifamily underwriting and waterfall model, with assessments along the way to prove I've actually learned the material.



At a glance:

• Role: Private tutor / instructor 

• Schedule: Twice per week (two 60–90 minute remote sessions)

• Format: Fully remote via Zoom/Teams with screen sharing and Excel work-alongs

• Rate: $5.5/hour USD (paid via Wise)

• Start date: Immediate, upon successful interview



What You'll Be Teaching:

A structured curriculum of your own proposal, modeled on a university real estate development / real estate finance program, working out of a recognized textbook (e.g., Peter Linneman's Real Estate Finance and Investments or comparable). You will propose the syllabus and textbook in your application.



Core topic areas:

1. Foundations — time value of money, NPV/IRR/MIRR, cap rates, NOI, basis points, leverage concepts

2. Multifamily underwriting — rent rolls, market rents, vacancy and loss to lease, operating expenses and expense ratios, capital expenditures, debt terms (amortization, DSCR, loan sizing), investor pro forma conventions

3. Financial modeling in Excel — building a complete multifamily acquisition model from scratch, with sensitivity tables, scenario analysis, and clean formatting standards

4. Waterfalls and syndication math — preferred returns, return of capital, catch-up tranches, promote/carried interest, IRR-hurdle-based distribution waterfalls for LP/GP structures

5. Development topics — land/entitlement basics, ground-up feasibility analysis, construction budgeting and draws, permanent loan takeout, developer profit and developer waterfalls



Curriculum Structure Requirements:

• University-style curriculum: You will map out a semester-style syllabus with weekly topics tied to assigned textbook readings before we begin.

• Work out of a textbook: Each session should build on assigned reading and problem sets.

• Quizzes: Short quizzes at regular mile markers (roughly every 3–4 weeks) covering prior material.

• Tests/exams: Longer assessments at major milestones (mid-program and capstone), including a hands-on modeling exam where I build or repair a model under time constraint.

• Capstone project: A complete multifamily acquisition model built by me from scratch, including an equity waterfall tab, reviewed and graded by you.



Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience underwriting or acquiring multifamily assets (e.g., work at an acquisitions shop, appraisal firm, brokerage, developer, or lending institution)

• Advanced, demonstrable Excel modeling skills (clean formula design, scenario toggles, waterfall logic — no copy-paste templates)

• Practical familiarity with distribution waterfall math and GP/LP structures

• Prior tutoring, teaching, or training experience required

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and dual-screen setup for screen-share lessons

• Ability to commit to a fixed twice-weekly schedule for at least 3–6 months



Nice to Have:

• Familiarity with US markets and conventions (Argus, CoStar, or similar exposure is a plus but not required — this course is Excel-native)

• Experience building development / construction-draw models

• Textbook-honed problem-solving: you should be comfortable assigning and grading exercises from a real estate finance text



To Apply:

Please send

1. A resume

2. A brief summary of your multifamily underwriting/modeling experience (deals, roles, tools)

3. A proposed curriculum outline: the textbook you'd use, a week-by-week topic list

4. A sample of your modeling work (screenshots welcome; formulas visible)

5. Your availability (EST) and confirmation you can commit to two sessions per week

title: Short-Form Video Creator for Meta Andromeda Ads (Reels, Instagram, Facebook) | Music Promotion
description:
ABOUT US

We are a music promotion company that helps independent artists get their music heard. We run curated Spotify playlists and a set of Instagram accounts that connect artists with real listeners. Most new artists find us through our paid ads on Instagram and
, so the quality of our video ads directly affects how fast we grow.

We are looking for a creative, data-minded video creator who can turn a scroll into a click.



THE ROLE

You will create video content for several of our music playlists, each with its own genre and audience:

- Indie Rock

- Hip-Hop

- Neoclassical

- Soul & R&B

- Lo-Fi

- [and more]

Each playlist needs its own visual style and tone. A Lo-Fi ad should not feel like a Hip-Hop ad. You need to be able to switch styles and still keep the content strong.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Create short vertical videos (9:16) for Reels, Stories and Meta feed ads, aimed at independent musicians and artists

- Produce a high volume of genuinely different ad concepts: new hooks, angles, formats, visual styles and messages, not just small edits of the same video

- Write scroll-stopping hooks for the first 1 to 3 seconds, plus short on-screen text and captions

- Use AI tools (video generation, voiceover, editing, captioning, image generation) to produce content quickly without losing quality

- Review ad performance with us (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per click, landing page views) and use the results to plan the next round of creatives

- Keep creatives within Meta's ad policies and music licensing rules, so ads don't get rejected or muted

- Organize and label all creatives so we can track which concepts win



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- A portfolio of short-form videos or ads you made yourself. Paid social ads with results are a big plus.

- A solid understanding of how Meta Andromeda changed advertising: the creative now does most of the targeting, broad audiences are standard, and the algorithm rewards real creative diversity over many near-identical variations

- Hands-on experience with AI content tools (for example CapCut, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, or similar). Tell us which ones you use.

- Strong editing skills: pacing, captions, transitions, sound design, text animation

- Good written English for hooks and on-screen copy aimed at a Western audience of musicians

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and deliver in batches

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video editing



NICE TO HAVE

- Knowledge of the music industry, Spotify, playlists or independent artist culture

- Experience with Meta Ads Manager and reading ad performance data

- Motion graphics or basic animation skills

- Experience with UGC-style or faceless content formats



WHAT WE OFFER

- Creative freedom to test new ideas, with clear feedback based on real ad data

- Performance-based raises as your creatives prove themselves



HOW WE START: PAID TRIAL

We start with a paid trial on 2 of our playlists: Lo-Fi and Indie Rock. This lets you see how we work and lets us see your work.

- Duration: [e.g. 2 weeks]

- Deliverables: [e.g. 6 to 8 distinct ad creatives per playlist]

- Trial pay: [e.g. PHP X fixed for the full trial]



Lo-Fi calls for a calm, aesthetic, atmospheric style. Indie Rock calls for energy, attitude and raw visuals. We want to see that you can do both well.



We judge the trial on creative quality and on real ad performance. If it's a good match, you'll take over video content for our other playlists (Hip-Hop, Neoclassical, Soul & R&B and more) and move to a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you created (ads preferred)

2. The AI tools you use and what you use each one for

3. In 3 to 5 sentences: how has Meta Andromeda changed the way you would build ad creatives for a new campaign?

4. Your expected monthly rate and available hours

5. A rough idea for one ad that would make an independent Lo-Fi or Indie Rock artist want to submit their song to a playlist



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short paid test task. The best candidate then moves on to the paid trial with our Lo-Fi and Indie Rock playlists.

title: Social Media and Content Manager
description:
Simon Says Pet is a rescue-owned pet brand based in Bellevue, Washington, selling direct at 
. We are a new brand, launched in October 2026, and we expect to grow fast. We are hiring one person in the Philippines to create on-brand content in Larven, run our social channels, and grow them against aggressive weekly targets. Pet brand experience required. Do not apply unless you are willing to be diligent and motivated.



What you will own



- Content creation in Larven. Build the weekly content set for each product from a written brief: three short videos and two statics, on brand and ready to post.

- Brand accuracy. Every piece follows our brand rules exactly: fonts, colors, logo use, true product scale and labels, real rescue dogs. You run every piece of content through Claude for accuracy and check it against the brand checklist before it reaches the founder.

- Social media management. Plan, schedule and post daily on Instagram and
, 6 times a week on TikTok and twice a week on LinkedIn. Reply to comments and messages from our answer library.

- Growth. Own follower growth, reach and site visits from social. Run partner collaborations, story shares and giveaways to get there. Our rescue partners are the fastest route: you tag them, cross post with them and get them sharing our content every week.

- Reporting. Send a one page report every Monday: followers by platform, reach, link clicks, site visits from social, the best post, and what you will change next week. You can use Claude to create and run this report automatically.



How success is measured



Targets are set in writing in your first week and reviewed every Monday. They are aggressive on purpose.



- Followers on every platform grow each week from the week one baseline

- 300 or more site visits a week from social within the first 30 days

- Every scheduled post goes out on time

- Zero spelling, grammar or brand errors in published work

- The Monday report arrives every Monday without a reminder



Requirements



- Flawless written English. Captions, graphics and video text must be 100% accurate in spelling, grammar and usage. There is a short writing and proofreading test. Errors result in docked hours or termination - we do not pay for your mistakes.

- Proven social growth. Two or more years managing social media for a US consumer brand, with account growth you can show in numbers.

- Partner growth. You must know how to grow accounts fast through partners: tagging, cross posting, collab posts and shares with our rescue partners and their followers. This is how a new brand grows fast, and it is not optional.

- AI content creation. Hands-on experience making ads and social content with AI tools. Larven experience is a plus, and we will train the right person. Larven makes your job easier.

- Brand discipline. A sharp eye for consistency and the mandate of following a style guide without exceptions.

- Short form video. You can produce and edit Reels and TikToks that look native to each platform.

- Availability. At least two hours a day of overlap with US Pacific morning hours. You are reachable on Slack every working day, reply the same day, and request time off in advance.

- Your own setup. Your own computer, software and reliable internet, plus your own Claude subscription. We do not pay for that subscription.

- Dog person. You love dogs. Rescue or shelter experience is a plus.



How we work



- Independent contractor, 20 to 35 hours a week, with more hours as results come in. If you perform, this can convert to a full time position

- Paid hourly in USD every two weeks through Wise, against a time log and the weekly deliverables list

- This is a one person role. You do the work yourself, with no subcontracting

- The first 15 days are a paid trial with a written review at the end

- A signed NDA is required before you start

- We provide access to Larven, Meta Business Suite, TikTok, Slack and Google Drive. You supply your own Claude subscription



How to apply



Send one message with:



1. Links to two or three accounts you have managed, with before and after follower numbers and the dates

2. Three pieces of content you made with an AI tool

3. A 150 word note on what you would change on our Instagram in your first 30 days

4. Your hourly rate in USD and the hours you can work in US Pacific time



Shortlisted candidates complete a short writing and proofreading test: five captions and a proofreading exercise. The test is not paid. Your first Larven content set is built in week one of the trial.

title: AI Video Pipeline Integrator : Viral Trend Discovery + End-to-End Automation
description:
We are looking for someone who can integrate our requirements into an existing content production pipeline:



We need a faceless short-form video pipeline for a consumer mobile app, published to IG Reels and TikTok. We also need viral topic discovery feeding into that pipeline, something like Claude content skills or alt.



The ideal outcome is: we evaluate what's available, we build the fastest path to a working pipeline, and then implement and document it. Whether its Geelark, fcloud, DuoPlus, OgPhone. etc. 



What You Will Do:



Evaluate existing pipelines or templates (your own, open-source, or commercially available) against our requirements: viral trend discovery, simple AI video generation (slideshow/reaction/app demo), and automated publishing to IG and TikTok.



Adapt and integrate. Use AI generation APIs, and publishing tools where possible.



Build or integrate a viral topic discovery layer that feeds the pipeline: scan TikTok/IG Reels for our niche, identify rising patterns, and convert them into generation prompts. We want viral pattern tracking and replication analysis. Tell us why a specific video went viral, and how to reproduce that pattern with our app.



Document the system , record walkthroughs explaining each major workflow, provide exportable workflow files, create workflow diagrams, and produce a step-by-step runbook so it can be maintained. 



NOT a fit:



People who propose building an entire platform from scratch. We want integration, not a software project.



Video editors who use AI tools manually. We are hiring for a system, not a person who clicks "generate" for each video.



Generic automation pitches with no live channel or published samples behind them. Resold templates with no proof of actual output will not be considered.



People who use generic "trend lists" as a deliverable.



People who just mention a tool or Skill by name without being able to explain specifically which one, how it connects to the pipeline, and what its output looks like.



"I can build this" with no sample. We will assume you cannot.



****************To Apply, Please Provide***********:



Start your proposal with the word INTEGRATE followed by the name of the existing pipeline or template you would start from.



A live sample. One short video produced by a pipeline you have already built or adapted. A published link (TikTok/IG/YouTube) is preferred over a file export. Tell us what was pre-existing versus what you customized, and how much human time went in after the pipeline ran.



A trend discovery sample. Input a niche keyword, output the viral pattern analysis and the prompt/script generated from it. Tell us which tools/APIs you used for scraping and which model for analysis.



Your recommended integration path in one paragraph: given our requirements, what existing pipeline would you start from, what would you change, and what breaks first at 50 videos/week.



Cost per video for your recommended path, broken down by API, plus a cheaper alternative if one exists.

ABOUT THE BUSINESS

Orders go out through a fulfilment partner (from China), and delivery takes about 11 days. I'm a hands-on owner, and I want customers to feel they're dealing with a real, caring brand, while minimising refunds and chargebacks. I'm looking for someone dependable to take customer support and
 post comment moderation off my plate (for the most part).



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1) Customer
 support (main task, will take roughly 30 minutes - 1 hour daily)

- Check each brand's inbox daily.

- Answer every real customer
, and notify me of anything important or things that may need my attention.

- Flag important account
s to me straight away: PayPal cases and disputes, chargebacks, Shopify or PayPal account warnings.

- Look up each order in Shopify and check its tracking before replying.

- At the start, you'll just write drafts for every reply and I'll approve it before it's sent. Once you know the rules well, you'll answer standard enquiries on your own.



Common enquiries and how I handle them:

- "Where is my order?": check the tracking. If it's within about 11 days, reassure the customer and give further details if necessary. If it's late, follow a separate late-order format.

- Incomplete addresses: if an address is missing a house number or street, politely ask the customer for their full address and apologise for the delay.

- Missing or damaged items: apologise, ask for a photo/video.

- Returns: give the returns address and ask the customer to include their order number. 

- Refunds: I process refunds myself. You'll recommend a refund when it's the right call, then confirm with the customer once I've done it. 

- Discounts: offer a partial refund only after repeated delays or to a very frustrated customer, and always state it as a percentage (e.g. "20%"), never as an amount of money.

- Product questions: answer from the product page and our notes. If you're not 100% sure, especially about anything to do with safety or electrics, don't guess. Flag it to me.

- PayPal cases and chargebacks: preventing them is a top priority. Spot unhappy customers early, de-escalate, and let me know immediately when a case is opened, with its deadline.



Always escalate to me:

- any PayPal case, chargeback or legal or Trading Standards threat

- refund requests or any customer threatening a claim

- any question where the honest answer isn't clear, or where a wrong answer could be checked and proven false

-
s that arrive for the wrong brand



2)
 page and ad comment management (will take roughly 5-15 minutes daily)

- Every day, go through all of my brands
 pages and the comments on my running ad posts. 

- Hide every negative comment. That includes complaints, "scam" accusations, delivery moans, competitor links and spam.

- If a negative comment is from a real customer with an order problem, hide it and send me a note so we can sort it privately.



TONE AND STANDARDS

- Warm, polite, short and genuinely helpful, in natural English. No robotic help-desk phrases.

- Sign off most
s with "Kind regards," followed by the brand name. No personal names.

- Never share chinese supplier or fulfilment details, where orders ship from, or dispatch dates. Only give the local courier and their tracking number (for example Evri, Royal Mail, An Post or USPS), never the earlier long-haul tracking codes.

- Quote delivery as "up to about 11 days".

- Keep
s short. Lead with the answer and apologise where it's due.



Example of the style I want:

"I'm sorry your order is taking longer to deliver than expected. This is due to delays in shipping, but it's now with evri (last mile carrier) and will be delivered within the next few days. You can track the order yourself using your Evri tracking number [number].

Kind regards, Stillwell"



IDEAL CANDIDATE

- Native-level written English, with good spelling and grammar.

- At least 1 year in e-commerce customer support. Shopify experience is a big plus.

- Experience moderating
 pages or ad comments in Meta Business Suite.

- Reliable and consistent.

- Good judgement: you know when to answer, when to ignore and when to escalate. Do not be afraid to bring cases to me when you don't know exactly how to respond.

- Tools you'll use: Shopify admin, a business
 inbox, a parcel tracking site (17track), Meta Business Suite



HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

- Accuracy: Customer
s promptly answered. Every order update and inquiry answered as correctly as possible.

- Ability to spot and defuse escalating disputes with customers so there are fewer PayPal cases and chargebacks.

-
 pages checked every day, with negative comments hidden within 24 hours.

- How few corrections I need to make to your drafts over time.



TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "Read" so I know you read the whole post. Then tell me about your customer support experience, if any

title: AI Automation Specialist (Claude + Google Workspace) for Real Estate Agency
description:
We're a real estate agency in Australia: residential sales, off-the-plan apartments, and 300+ managed rentals. We already use Claude AI every day across the business. What we don't have is someone to turn that into systems that run on their own, every night and every week, without a director babysitting them.



That's the job: a fixed-price build first, then a small monthly retainer.



FIRST BUILD (fixed price)

A nightly data pipe from PropertyMe into Google Sheets: arrears, vacancies, lease expiries, inspections, maintenance jobs, managements gained and lost. No browser, no computer left switched on. It runs unattended and alerts us if it fails.

Done means: 7 nights straight with no failures, figures match PropertyMe on spot checks, and a written runbook plus walkthrough video handed over.



WHAT COMES NEXT (quoted separately, one at a time)

- Weekly staff performance scorecard (Gmail, PropertyMe, call logs, Google Chat, Trello)

- Live directors' dashboard and team operations dashboard, including Xero

- Sales forms and AML filing: auto-named, auto-filed, gaps flagged weekly

- Listing marketing hub: photos in, on-brand Canva brochures, window cards and social posts out

- Vendor proposals with comparable sales from a compliant data source

- WordPress website: staging, backups, safe content and SEO updates

- Rolling Claude out to more staff with shared skills



THEN A MONTHLY RETAINER

A couple of hours once a month for administration and updates: review everything you've built, fix anything broken and apply updates.



OUR STACK

Google Workspace, PropertyMe, Reapit Sales, Dripflow, Canva, WordPress, 2Apply, Xero, Trello, Smallpdf, Claude Team.



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU

- Have shipped real Claude automations (MCP connectors, skills, Claude Code), not just prompts

- Know Google Apps Script and the Google Workspace APIs

- Work comfortably with APIs and n8n, Make or Zapier

- Have PropertyMe or Australian property management experience (a big plus)

- Document what you build and hand over cleanly

- Can overlap with Australian east coast business hours (AEDT, 3 hours ahead of Manila)



NON-NEGOTIABLES

- You work inside our Google Workspace. We give you a company Google account, and all your files, scripts, documentation and communication with us stay in it

- Least-privilege access, and never write access to trust accounting or bank details

- Everything you build lives in our accounts, and we own it

- NDA and Australian Privacy Act compliance

- A human approves anything before it goes to a client



TO APPLY

Start your message with the words "Nightly pipe", then send:

1. Your approach, fixed price and timeline for the PropertyMe build

2. How you'd connect to PropertyMe and what you'd need from us

3. One or two automations you've shipped, and what they replaced

4. Your monthly retainer price and your hourly rate for new builds



Generic template replies won't be read.

title: Partnership Lead
description:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.



Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.



In addition to our core business, Workstream has a small, fast-moving Data Labs team. We are building one of the largest collections of real-world work data in the Philippines, by partnering with businesses whose teams wear AI-enabled hats while they work. Partner businesses earn for every productive hour their team contributes.



What We Offer



Base salary: $1,000 per month

Commission: $ 0.20 for every deliverable hour your partners contribute, for as long as they continue delivering

Gas stipend: Provided for every day you are out in the field

Full training: Comprehensive training on the entire data collection operation

Growth opportunities:  A ground-floor role in a fast-growing AI program, with a potential path to Senior Partnership Lead or Partnership Manager

Contract: Initial 3-month contract, with the possibility of renewal depending on your performance and the overall success and needs of the project

Grow With Us



Workstream is looking for a Partnerships Manager to join our growing Data Labs Team. You will own your territory end to end. You find the right businesses, show them how the program works, sign them as partners, and go on-site to get their teams started. Then you turn happy partners into referrals for the next ones.



This is a full-cycle, field-first role for someone who likes meeting business owners face to face, moves fast, and gets the details right.



Territory Coverage

This is a region-based role covering key business hubs across the Philippines. You will be assigned a territory within one of the following areas:



Greater NCR: Metro Manila, Bulacan, Rizal, Cavite, Laguna, and Batangas

Central Luzon: Pampanga and Tarlac

Central Visayas: Metro Cebu

Western Visayas: Iloilo and Bacolod

Mindanao: Metro Davao



Day in the Life:



Find partners: build a pipeline of small, mid-sized and large businesses across many industries in your territory.

Qualify them: learn how each team works and where, and check that it is a good fit for the program.

Close partnerships: present the program to owners and decision-makers, and get agreements signed.

Onboard on-site: visit each partner, set expectations with their point of contact, train their team, and collect accurate business details.

Hand off and grow: introduce each partner to our support team, then ask for referrals and testimonials to keep the pipeline full.



Who You Are:



Experience:



2+ years in field sales, business development, account management or partnerships

Experience selling to business owners, especially small and mid-sized businesses

A track record of hitting targets in a fast-paced, high-volume role

Skills

Comfortable walking into a business and getting to the decision-maker

Clear, confident communicator in Filipino and English, and able to explain something new simply

Detail-oriented: you collect complete, accurate information every time

Organised: you can manage a large pipeline and a full calendar of site visits

Tech-comfortable: smartphone, spreadsheets, simple apps, and basic troubleshooting on-site



Nice to have:



A local business network in your territory

Experience in industries with hands-on work, such as retail, food service, logistics, construction or manufacturing

Your own motorcycle or car and a valid driver's license



What to expect:



You will be in the field most days, visiting several businesses a day across your territory.

You will own the full cycle, from first conversation to a team that is up and running.

You will work to weekly targets for businesses qualified, signed and onboarded, with clear coaching along the way.

You will get full training on the program and our operations in your first two weeks, alongside the rest of your cohort.

You will join early. This is a fast-growing program, with room to grow into senior and leadership roles as we expand.

title: Full Time Live Transfer Agent
description:
Now Hiring | Full-Time Live Transfer Agent

Valorian Financial Insurance Group · Remote · Commission Only



We’re hiring two live transfer agents. You’ll call people who’ve requested life insurance information, confirm they’re interested, and introduce them to one of our licensed agents while they’re still on the line. Our sales team handles the close. We provide the leads, dialer, and training.



Earn 5% on every deal we close from your transfers, with no cap. A $1,200 deal earns you $60. If 10 of your transfers close at that amount in one week, you earn $600 USD that week. Keep that pace for four weeks and you earn $2,400 USD. Every additional sale adds to your pay. If you do the math this is $8-$15 per hour or more for top performers. 



You’ll need clear spoken English, reliable internet, a headset, and the appropriate life insurance license for commission-based referrals.



To apply, message us with your availability and a few lines about your outbound calling, appointment-setting, or live transfer experience.

Hands-on experience connecting WordPress to Moodle or a comparable learning management system through APIs or web services.

Experience building student portals, member dashboards, or enrolment and approval workflows.

Comfortable working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and an existing WordPress design. Familiarity with Elementor is an asset.

Availability Between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM Toronto time for communication, daily check-ins, and occasional Zoom meetings

title: DTC Creative Strategist
description:
We run direct response ecommerce brands on paid social. Creative is the only real lever left, and creative only works when it is built on genuine customer understanding rather than guesswork.



We are hiring one person to sit alongside the founder every day and own the research-to-script pipeline. You dig into the market, find out what customers actually feel and fear and want, turn that into new angles and avatars, and produce the scripts and briefs our editors turn into ads. The founder handles the ad account and feeds you the results. Your job is to work out what those results mean and what we do next.



This is not a coordination role. You are not managing a calendar or chasing assets. You are the person who finds the insight and writes the thing.



What you will actually do



Deep customer research



Mine voice of customer at volume: Reddit threads, Amazon and competitor reviews (especially the one and two star ones), YouTube and TikTok comment sections,
 groups, forums, Quora, post-purchase surveys, support tickets, our own ad comment sections.

Pull direct language out of it. Not summaries. The exact phrasing people use when they describe the problem to a friend.

Build and maintain a swipe of pain points, emotional triggers, objections, purchase anxieties, failed prior solutions, and the specific moment that pushes someone from tolerating the problem to buying a fix.

Run and interpret real customer research: surveys, buyer interviews, post-purchase questionnaires, review analysis. You should be comfortable getting on a call with a customer and asking the uncomfortable follow-up question.

Segment what you find into distinct avatars with distinct triggers, not one blurred "target customer."



Competitor and market research



Systematic teardowns of every meaningful competitor: their ad library, their creative formats, which ads have been running longest and at what volume, their funnel, their landing pages, their offer, their pricing, their review sentiment, their weak points.

Track what is scaling in adjacent categories and steal the structure, not the copy.

Identify where the market is in terms of sophistication and awareness, and what that means for the claims we can make and the way we have to open an ad.

Find the gaps. Where is every competitor saying the same thing, and what is the unclaimed position.



Angles and avatars



Generate new angles continuously. Most will die. That is expected. We want volume of genuine swings, each one traceable back to a specific piece of evidence.

Every angle comes with a rationale: which avatar, which pain point, which awareness stage, which competitor claim it displaces, why now.

Develop and articulate mechanisms. Why does this product work, explained in a way that is concrete, ownable and believable rather than generic.



We read every application properly, so we expect the same in return. Start your application with the answer to 4+4 on the first line, nothing else on that line. Anything without it goes in the bin unread.



Scripts and briefs



Write ad scripts for static, UGC, talking head and b-roll voiceover formats. Written to be spoken, not written to be read.

Write briefs our editors can execute without coming back with questions: reference material, pacing, on-screen text, b-roll requirements, tone, and what the ad is actually trying to do.

Write and iterate primary text, headlines, hooks, and supporting funnel copy including advertorials, listicles and landing page sections.

Produce hook variations at volume and understand the difference between testing a hook and testing an ad.



Creative feedback loop



You will not be in the ad account. The founder reports the results back to you: what spent, what converted, hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS.

Your job is the diagnosis. Given those numbers, why did this ad win or lose, and is the problem the hook, the angle, the avatar, the proof, the offer or the format.

Turn every test into a documented learning about the customer, not just a verdict on the ad.

Maintain the creative learning log so we stop relearning the same lesson, and translate each learning into the next round of scripts.

What we are looking for



Non-negotiable



You have written ad creative that has spent real money on Meta and you can explain what worked and why.

You can research. Genuinely research. Not read three Reddit threads and write a persona document full of adjectives.

You write in spoken language. If your copy sounds like marketing, it will not survive here.

You understand direct response fundamentals: mass desire, market sophistication, awareness stages, mechanism, proof, objection handling. Familiarity with Schwartz's Breakthrough Advertising is a strong signal, and we will assume you have read it.

You can take a set of reported metrics and reason from them accurately. You do not need to be a media buyer, but you need to know what a high hook rate with a dead CTR is telling you.

You work fast and iterate without ego. Creative gets killed here on data, not on taste.

You are self-directed. We will tell you the objective, not the steps.

Excellent written English and a good ear for regional voice differences across AU, NZ, UK, US and CA.



Strong advantage



Experience with competitive intelligence and scraping tools (ad library tools, review scrapers, comment scrapers, AI research workflows).

Comfort with AI tooling as a research and production accelerant, paired with the judgment to know when its output is generic filler.

Experience briefing editors and knowing what is realistic to produce.

Background in one of: supplements, consumer hardware, home and auto, pet, or another problem-solution physical product category.

Basic ability to build or mock up static creative concepts so briefs are unambiguous.



Not a fit if



You need a detailed brief before you can start.

Your research process is asking an AI for a customer persona.

You think great creative is a matter of opinion.

You want to work on brand awareness, brand books, or anything that cannot be measured within seven days.

How we work

Daily contact with the founder. Fast async communication, short calls, no meeting theatre.

We test in structured rounds with clean variables. One meaningful change per cell wherever possible.

Every recommendation is expected to carry its evidence. "I think" is fine, as long as it is followed by "because customers in this segment keep saying X."

Premium positioning standard across everything we produce. Direct response discipline, but nothing that looks or sounds cheap.

title: Ophthalmic Scribe
description:
Job Title: Virtual Ophthalmology Medical Scribe (Full-Time / Remote)



Salary: $7/hr (paid weekly as a salary)



Hours: 40 hours/week | US Clinic Hours (e.g., 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST / 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM PHT)



Employment Type: Full-Time, Long-Term



About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Virtual Ophthalmology Medical Scribe to support a busy US-based ophthalmology practice. Because eye clinics move at a high volume, you will work live alongside our ophthalmologists (via real-time audio/telehealth) to accurately chart slit-lamp exams, dilated fundus exams, diagnostic interpretations, and surgical plans directly into our ophthalmology-specific EHR, or document asynchronously based on AI scribe recordings. When the doctor is not in the office, you will help locate records for upcoming visits.



Key Responsibilities

Document real-time patient encounters, including History of Present Illness (HPI), ocular history, visual acuity (VA), intraocular pressure (IOP), refraction, and pupils/motility findings.



Accurately chart anterior segment (slit-lamp) and posterior segment (dilated fundus) exam findings for OD (right eye), OS (left eye), and OU (both eyes) without laterality errors.



Record physician interpretations of ophthalmic diagnostics, including OCT, Visual Fields (HVF), Fundus Photography, Fluorescein Angiography (FA), Corneal Topography, and B-Scans.



Enter diagnoses (ICD-10), ophthalmic procedures/injections (e.g., lasers, imaging tests), and surgical counseling notes (cataract/IOL options, glaucoma, retina, or oculoplastics).



Track and queue ophthalmic prescriptions (eye drops, tapers, systemic meds), follow-up intervals, and patient education instructions.



Prep charts ahead of clinic hours by pulling prior surgical dates, recent IOP trends, and diagnostic comparisons.



Maintain strict patient privacy and full HIPAA compliance at all times.



Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: Minimum of 3 months of experience as an Ophthalmology/Optometry Scribe or Ophthalmic Technician/Assistant (experience in retina, cataract, or glaucoma clinics is strongly preferred).



Ophthalmology Fluency: Solid command of ocular anatomy, ophthalmic abbreviations (OD/OS/OU, PERRLA, RAPD, PVD, AMD, DME, POAG, etc.), and ophthalmic medications.



EHR Familiarity: Hands-on experience with ophthalmology EHR platforms such as Modernizing Medicine (EMA), Nextech (IntelleChartPRO), Compulink, Eyefinity, or Epic Kaleidoscope, etc



Typing & Speed: Minimum of 65 WPM with high accuracy to keep pace with high-volume eye clinic workflows.



English Comprehension: Strong ability to follow fast-paced spoken medical terminology and subtle laterality cues (OD vs. OS).



Tech & Workspace Setup:



Private, quiet, HIPAA-compliant workspace (no shared rooms or audible audio bleed).



Primary wired/fiber internet (25+ Mbps) plus a reliable backup internet source.

title: Cold Caller / Outbound Lead Generator (Mineral Rights, US Eastern Hours)
description:
Freedom Mineral Partners is a US company that leases and purchases oil and gas mineral rights from landowners in Pennsylvania, Ohio, and West Virginia. We are hiring a full time cold caller to contact landowners by phone and find out if they are interested in leasing or selling their mineral rights.



This starts as a 2 week paid trial at the posted rate. If your call volume and lead quality are good, it converts to a long term full time position.



Pay is above the typical rate for this role because we expect strong English and consistent daily volume.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Log into our in-house CRM and power dialer each shift and work through assigned landowner lists

Call landowners using our script and ask if they are interested in leasing or selling their mineral rights

Answer basic questions, handle objections, and pass interested landowners to our land team

Log every call outcome, callback time, and note in the CRM

Make a minimum of 80 dials per day, tracked automatically by the dialer



WHAT WE PROVIDE



$7/hour base plus $10 for every qualified lead. A qualified lead is a landowner who confirms they own mineral rights in PA, OH, or WV, provides a verified callback number and mailing or
 address, agrees to receive a written offer, and is approved by our land team. Duplicates, wrong numbers, and owners already in our system do not count.

Our own CRM and power dialer, fully web based. No phone, dialer subscription, or calling minutes needed on your end

Script, FAQ, and training on mineral rights basics

Lead lists ready to call every day

Pay twice monthly via Wise or PayPal



REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken English with a neutral or light accent. This is a hard requirement

Fixed schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern time

Comfortable with high volume calling and hearing no most of the day

Comfortable learning new web software quickly. No prior CRM experience needed, we train you on ours

Laptop, noise canceling or USB headset, wired internet of at least 10 Mbps, and a backup connection or hotspot

Quiet workspace with no background noise during calls

Reachable on chat during your shift



NICE TO HAVE



Previous cold calling or appointment setting experience for US companies

Any knowledge of oil and gas, mineral rights, or land work, especially in the Appalachian Basin



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word MINERAL. Include a short voice recording (30 to 60 seconds) introducing yourself and reading this line: “Hi, this is [your name] calling on behalf of Freedom Mineral Partners. I’m reaching out to landowners in your county about their oil and gas mineral rights.” Applications without the word MINERAL and a voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: QA Tester (Full-Time) – AI Education App for US Teachers and Students (2 positions)

We're hiring 2 full-time QA testers for our three products:

- Nyclogic Co-Teacher: the teacher app for lesson planning and live classes

- Nyclogic Study: the student app, on phones and computers, in several languages

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run our daily test checklist on our test site: create test classes, present lessons, join as a student on a second device, submit work, and check that grades and screens update.

- Test real student journeys from start to finish: joining, signing back in, watching a video and returning to the lesson, exit tickets, and the phone app.

- Write clear bug reports: a one-line title, where it happened, device and browser, numbered steps, what you expected, what actually happened (with the exact error message), a screenshot, and the time. No videos.

- Re-test bugs after they're fixed.

- Report every day to our QA lead.

- Use test data only. Never use a real student's name.



HOURS

40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, mostly Manila daytime. Some overlap with US school hours (evening Manila) is a plus.



PAY

₱26,000 per month, paid twice a month by Wise. There is a paid trial task before hiring.



YOU MUST HAVE

- Strong written English and close attention to detail.

- A computer with Chrome, plus a smartphone (Android or iPhone). Both are needed: you'll often be the teacher and the student at the same time.

- Reliable internet with a backup.



NICE TO HAVE

- QA or software testing experience.

- Teaching or tutoring experience.

- Spanish or another language besides English and Filipino.



HOW TO APPLY (applications without all three won't be reviewed)

1. Subject line: Nyclogic QA Tester: [your name]

2. Write one bug you've noticed in any app or website you use, as a bug report in the format above.

3. List the devices you own (computer, phone model, operating system).

title: Media Buyer + AI
description:
=== About the business === 



My name is Jamie and I am a Singapore real estate advisor that helps homeowners build real wealth through property. Best known for upgrading clients to landed houses or higher-value homes, and for doing it with everyday homeowners, not just the already wealthy.



- S$180M+ in property transacted



- 75%+ of our clients have achieved capital gains of at least 20%



- Our core offer is a 1-to-1 strategy call. We map out a customized upgrade plan, then guide each client step by step towards generational wealth through real estate.



I get clients through webinars and high-ticket funnels.. The webinars add values to the homeowners then they get invited to book a 1-to-1 strategy call about how they can upgrade their property. 



=== The job ===



Fill my webinars at or under my cost-per-sale ceiling, and book qualified strategy calls at or under my cost-per-call ceiling.

You own two numbers:



- Cost per call sale from the webinar campaigns, at target class size



- Cost per qualified call booked from the book-a-call campaigns



I'll share the current numbers and the ceilings at the interview. 



=== What you'll do ===



You run two funnels on Meta, the same way:



- Set up and run conversion campaigns to the registration page. You own targeting, budgets, bids and daily optimisation.



- Test new ads every week and switch off the ones that stop producing.



- Tag every registrant with source, campaign and creative, so every sale traces back to the ad that produced it.



- Report the numbers every day: spend, registrations, cost per lead, cost per sale or call, and the one thing you changed.



1. Webinar campaigns. Two to four webinars a month. Each one needs a full room and a strong show-up rate. Your targets here are cost per registration, show-up rate and cost per course sale.



2. High-ticket book-a-call campaigns. Ads to webinar attendees, inviting them to apply for a call with me about upgrading their property. You also own the application form and the qualification criteria, so I only take calls with people who are a good fit. Your targets here are cost per application, cost per qualified call and call show-up rate.



3. The numbers, every day. One end-of-day report in five lines: spend, leads, cost per lead, cost per course sale or call booked, and the one thing you changed. One weekly review with Jamie: what to kill, keep and scale.



4. AI does the grunt work. You use AI tools daily for creative variations, video editing, ad copy, landing-page tests, audience research and reporting. One person with AI replaces the copywriter, designer and analyst we would otherwise need.



Tools you'll use: Meta Ads Manager, the HighLevel-based CRM (Intellia) for registrations and pipeline, Zoom webinars, Hyros, Google Sheets for the lead tracker, Claude and whichever AI tools you already work with.



=== Who we're looking for ===



Must-haves (all three):



- You have personally managed SGD 10,000+ a month on Meta for at least a year, with the account access to prove it



- You know your numbers by heart: ask you cost per lead, cost per sale and show-up on your last campaign



- You use AI tools every day for copy, creative and analysis, and can show us what you've built with them



Nice-to-haves:



- You've run webinar or event funnels, not just lead forms



- You've run ads for high ticket book a call funnels



- You've worked with HighLevel, Zapier, Hyros or n8n



This job is not for you if:



- You want to manage social media posts and count likes and shares. Here, only leads and sales count, and both are tracked.



- You wait to be told what to test next. I expect you to bring the next test to me.



- You want a standard 9-to-6 job. This job is about hitting numbers, not clocking hours. Some days are short; webinar days are not. When ad spend is high, you may need to check and report basic numbers on weekends too.



- You don't want to own an outcome. Every ad you run has a cost per sale or cost per call against your name, and we review it weekly.



and track like and shares without clear leads and sales tracking



=== What you get ===



- Salary plus a performance bonus. You own a result and get paid for moving it. Figures at interview.



- Work anytime, anywhere. I judge outcomes, not hours or location. Just be contactable during Singapore working hours.



- Clock real experience on real ad spend. Four to five figures a month on one account, with two to four live webinars a month to test against. You'll run more real tests in your first quarter here than most buyers run in a year, and you won't wait for sign-off to launch one.



- Learn from the best. I review your numbers with you weekly, and you get access to the media-buying and business advisors I've paid close to six figures to work with. Their playbooks and their feedback on your campaigns will skyrocket your skills.

AI does the boring work. No resizing banners. No writing twelve headlines by hand. We pay for your AI tools, and you're free to try new ones whenever you like.



- Career progression. As the business grows, you move up to higher-level work: funnel strategy, offers, new channels. And if you want to lead, you build and run the marketing team under you.



=== How to apply ===



Please complete the application form below carefully. The questions are designed to show me how you think, not just what tools you've used.



===> Apply here: 



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

You need to be able to answer:



Who owes what? When is it due? What is late? What needs follow-up? What has been completed? And what requires my decision?



10. Confidential Business Projects

HOURS & COMPENSATION

RIGHT HAND

title: Experienced U.S. Tax Preparer / Senior Tax Accountant
description:
Company: Ensign Partners

Location: Philippines, Remote

Job Type: Full-time, long-term

Compensation: $12–$15 USD per hour - negotiable based on experience. 

Schedule: Full-time U.S. Arizona business hours



ABOUT ENSIGN PARTNERS



Ensign Partners is an integrated professional services firm that brings legal, tax, financial, insurance, and business advisory services together under one team.



Our goal is not simply to complete individual tasks. We work together to help business owners organize their companies, make better decisions, protect what they have built, and confidently move their businesses forward.



We are building a team of dependable professionals who take ownership, communicate clearly, execute consistently, and care about the people they serve.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced U.S. Tax Preparer / Senior Tax Accountant based in the Philippines to join our growing Tax team.



This is a U.S. tax preparation position, NOT a bookkeeping position.



The ideal candidate has significant, hands-on experience preparing U.S. federal and state income tax returns for individuals and businesses, including Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



You must have actual experience preparing returns using professional U.S. tax software, preferably Intuit ProConnect Tax, and understand U.S. tax compliance, deductions, adjustments, supporting schedules, and filing requirements.



You will work directly with Ensign's U.S.-based Tax team to prepare accurate returns, identify issues, manage deadlines, and move completed work through review and authorized filing.



We are looking for someone who can independently prepare tax returns, not someone who needs to be trained in U.S. taxation from the beginning.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



U.S. TAX RETURN PREPARATION



Independently prepare U.S. individual income tax returns (Form 1040), including relevant schedules and supporting documentation.



Prepare U.S. business tax returns, including Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



Prepare applicable state income tax returns, extensions, and amended returns.



Review client financial statements, prior-year returns, and supporting records to identify missing information, discrepancies, and tax adjustments.



Apply U.S. federal and state tax rules to accurately calculate taxable income, deductions, credits, and other tax items.



Prepare complete tax workpapers and documentation for senior review.



Identify potential tax compliance issues and opportunities for tax planning.



Coordinate with the U.S. Tax team to resolve review comments and finalize returns for authorized filing.



TAX TEAM SUPPORT



Manage multiple tax returns and assignments while meeting internal deadlines and filing requirements.



Communicate missing information, outstanding questions, and tax issues to the appropriate team members.



Assist with tax research, estimated tax calculations, and other tax compliance projects.



Maintain accurate client records, tax documentation, and task updates.



Help improve tax preparation processes, checklists, and quality standards.



Collaborate with Ensign's Tax and advisory professionals to support accurate, timely client service.



CLIENT COMMUNICATION



Communicate professionally with U.S.-based clients and internal team members through
 and virtual meetings.



Request missing tax documents, financial information, and clarification when needed.



Explain tax-related questions clearly and professionally.



Provide consistent updates on assigned work and outstanding items.



Demonstrate accountability, accuracy, confidentiality, and dependable follow-through.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



Active Philippine CPA license or U.S. CPA credential preferred, with substantial U.S. tax preparation experience required.



5+ years of professional tax preparation experience, including at least 3 years preparing U.S. federal income tax returns.



Demonstrated hands-on experience preparing Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



Experience preparing U.S. federal and state tax returns using professional tax software.



Intuit ProConnect Tax experience strongly preferred.



Experience preparing complete returns for review, rather than only collecting documents or supporting bookkeeping.



Strong knowledge of U.S. federal income tax concepts, business entity taxation, deductions, depreciation, and tax adjustments.



Ability to read financial statements, review trial balances, and prepare tax-related adjusting entries.



Experience working with U.S.-based accounting or tax firms strongly preferred.



Strong Excel skills and familiarity with QuickBooks Online financial reports.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality, and meet deadlines.



IMPORTANT: We are specifically seeking applicants with proven U.S. tax return preparation experience. General accounting, Philippine tax compliance, and bookkeeping experience alone will not qualify for this position.



OUR CORE VALUES



ENJOY THE JOURNEY

We work hard, maintain perspective, support one another, and bring a positive attitude to the work we do.



MOVE THE CHEESE

We adapt when circumstances change. We do not remain stuck in old processes simply because they are familiar.



BE YOUR BEST

We prepare, improve, accept feedback, and consistently work to become better professionals and teammates.



AIM TO WIN

We approach our work with purpose. We set meaningful goals, solve problems, and focus on producing strong results.



RAISE THE BAR

We do not settle for average work. We look for ways to improve our quality, service, systems, and execution.



KEEP YOUR WORD

We do what we say we will do. When circumstances change, we communicate early and take responsibility.



STRONGER AS ONE

We share information, help our teammates, and make decisions based on what is best for the client and the entire company.



WHY JOIN ENSIGN PARTNERS?



Full-time, long-term opportunity.



Work with a growing U.S.-based professional services company.



Be part of a collaborative team.



Work directly with experienced business, legal, insurance, financial, and tax professionals.



Opportunity to grow as Ensign Partners grows.



Make a meaningful contribution to our clients and our team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions carefully.



Do NOT
 us directly. Applicants who
 outside this job posting will be disqualified.



Use this subject line: Experienced U.S. Tax Preparer at Ensign Partners



Include the following: Your updated resume.

A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in this position.

How many years of hands-on U.S. tax return preparation experience do you have?

Which U.S. tax forms have you personally prepared? Specify Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



Compensation is $12–$15 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated experience and qualifications. Our main goal is we get the right candidates.



Work hours are full-time U.S. Arizona business hours. This is a FULL TIME, LONG TERM position.
