title: Business Development Representative – Senior Living Partnerships
description:
Every person has a story worth keeping. Our client helps people preserve and share their life stories, and they're looking for a Business Development Representative to bring that experience to more retirement communities and senior living facilities.



This is a remote, outbound role for an experienced sales professional who builds relationships rather than pushing hard. You'll prospect by phone and
, earn the attention of busy facility leaders, and book meetings that turn into storytelling events, vendor tables, and partnerships. If you have a background in sales, enjoy connecting with people, and are comfortable with outbound outreach and building new business relationships, we'd love to hear from you. Experience in healthcare or senior care is a plus, but we're also open to candidates with strong sales or business development experience in other industries.



Responsibilities

- Reach out by phone and
 to retirement communities, senior living facilities, and other organizations that could become partners.

- Find and engage Recreation Managers, General Managers, Directors, and other decision-makers, then introduce what the company offers.

- Spark interest and set meetings with the client for vendor tables, storytelling events, and other activities at partner facilities.

- Use existing lead lists, industry event contacts, association directories, and other sources to find promising partners.

- Show facilities what they gain: storytelling experiences for their residents, plus complimentary marketing content created through those activities.

- Stay in touch with prospects, respond to objections thoughtfully, and keep finding ways to reach busy facility contacts.

- Explore partnership opportunities with long-term care facilities, churches, legions, and other community organizations.

- Help find ways to generate interest from residents and consumers as part of the overall outreach strategy.

- Log leads, track outreach activity, and manage your pipeline in HubSpot.

- Pass along what you hear from prospects so the team can sharpen its sales messaging and business development approach.

- Work closely with the client, follow early guidance and priorities, and own your day-to-day outreach.



Requirements

- 3+ years in sales development, business development, inside sales, appointment setting, or a related sales role.

- A proven track record in outbound prospecting, cold calling, lead generation, and sales follow-ups.

- Experience with retirement communities, senior living facilities, long-term care facilities, or other healthcare-related organizations is highly preferred.

- A background in healthcare staffing, recruiting agencies, or companies serving healthcare and senior care facilities is a strong advantage.

- Experience speaking with facility staff, managers, directors, and other organizational leaders.

- Previous work with the U.S.-based clients.

- You hold engaging conversations and build rapport easily with all kinds of people.

- You're friendly, bubbly, and empathetic, and you connect naturally with older adults and people from different backgrounds.

- You handle objections calmly and follow up consistently without being aggressive.

- You're proactive, take initiative, and manage your outreach independently.

- You juggle multiple tasks and keep lead information and sales activity up to date.

- You're comfortable learning and using CRM and communication tools such as HubSpot and RingCentral.

- You follow direction and work closely with the client early on, then take on more ownership of the outreach process over time.

- You genuinely care about the company's mission and the value of preserving people's stories and experiences.

- Must be available for graveyard shifts aligned with U.S. time zones.

- Must have a reliable internet connection and a dedicated work-from-home setup.



Salary and Benefits:

- Base salary: PHP 55,000 per month

- 100% remote, work from home

- PTO and paid holidays



Application Instructions

Ready to apply? Please send your CV as a link to a publicly accessible PDF on Google Drive. It must be a direct link to the file, not a folder or a Google Doc.

Links from Dropbox, OneDrive, OnlineJobs, or other similar platforms, as well as non-direct file links, may not be reviewed by our Talent Team.

Please also include:

- A short note on why you're a great fit for this role

- This Job ID in your
 subject line: recD5391cWejT6A2k

- This exact message in your
 body: "I'm excited to be applying to Job recD5391cWejT6A2k!"



These details help us find your application quickly and show us you've read the full job description. Attention to detail matters in this role. We look forward to hearing your story!

title: Senior US Tax Accountant & Financial Manager (Hospice & Healthcare)
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a high-caliber Philippine Licensed CPA, US Enrolled Agent (EA), or Senior US Tax Specialist to take full ownership of financial operations, global cash-flow analysis, and tax compliance for a growing portfolio of US healthcare and hospice entities, along with related commercial property holding companies.

In this role, you will lead complex multi-entity accounting in QuickBooks, maintain bank-ready financial records, manage global cash flow, and oversee complete federal and state tax filing processes. You will report directly to executive leadership to ensure our global financial presentation, balance sheets, and debt structures meet bank and credit committee underwriting standards.



Key Responsibilities

 US Federal & State Tax Management: Prepare, review, and manage federal (Form 1040, 1065, 1120/1120-S) and multi-state tax returns across our healthcare, hospice, and property entities, ensuring strict IRS compliance and relocation/multi-state tax planning.

 

Underwriting & Bank-Ready Financial Statements: Maintain precise, audit-ready financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and global cash-flow models to support commercial credit reviews, bank financing applications, and executive decision-making.

 

QuickBooks Administration & Cleanups: Direct chart of accounts setup, multi-entity account reconciliations, historical cleanups, and routine maintenance across QuickBooks Online and Desktop.

 

Healthcare & Hospice Operational Accounting: Manage granular expense tracking, operational budgets, revenue cycle workflows, and debt service tracking tailored to hospice and healthcare facility operations.

Qualifications & Requirements

 

Licensure / Credentials (Any of the following):

 Active Philippine Licensed CPA (PRC), OR

 Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) status, OR

 Passed US CPA Exam / Active US CPA License (Highly Preferred).

 

US Taxation & Underwriting Expertise: 3–5+ years of hands-on experience handling complex US federal/state returns, global cash-flow analysis, and tax compliance across multiple entities.



 Industry Focus: Direct prior experience in healthcare, hospice, medical practice, or commercial real estate accounting.

 QuickBooks Mastery: Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Desktop (QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is a strong plus).

 

Technical Workspace Setup: High-speed internet with power backup, a dedicated quiet workspace, and strict adherence to handling confidential health and financial records.



How to Apply:



To apply, please submit your application with the following:



1. Updated Resume / CV detailing your direct experience with US tax filings, QuickBooks multi-entity management, and healthcare/hospice financial operations.



2. A brief summary highlighting:

 The specific US tax forms you have prepared (1040, 1065, 1120/1120-S).



 The number of healthcare, hospice, or property entities you have managed simultaneously.



3. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

title: Marketplace Graphic Designer - Amazon Listing Images, A+ Content & AI Image Manipulation
description:
Role Overview



We are looking for an experienced Marketplace Graphic Designer to join our Marketplace Operations Team at TaskOn eCommerce.



This role primarily focuses on creating high-quality Amazon Listing Images, A+ Content, Amazon Brand Store designs, and AI-generated product visuals. We need someone who understands Amazon's creative requirements, has strong photo manipulation skills, and knows how to use AI tools to create realistic, professional, and conversion-focused product images.



While Amazon will be your primary focus, our Marketplace Operations Team also supports other eCommerce platforms, including Wayfair, Walmart, and other online marketplaces.



From time to time, you may be asked to assist with creative requirements for these platforms. This typically involves resizing, adjusting, reformatting, or reusing existing product images originally designed for Amazon to meet the requirements of other marketplaces.



This is not a separate role or a major shift in responsibilities. Cross-platform creative support is part of the position, while Amazon remains the main priority.



The ideal candidate is creative, detail-oriented, reliable, and capable of producing high-quality designs independently while managing multiple projects in a fast-paced eCommerce environment.



We are looking to fill this position ASAP, with preference given to applicants based in Davao City or anywhere in Mindanao, but everyone is still welcome.



Position Details

Role: Marketplace Graphic Designer (Amazon-Focused)

Department: Marketplace Operations

Company: TaskOn eCommerce



Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote

Experience Required: Minimum 2 years in Amazon Graphic Design or eCommerce Product Design

Location Preference: Davao City or anywhere in Mindanao

Work Schedule: Graveyard Shift (Pacific Standard Time Business Hours), Monday to Friday

Primary Tools: Adobe Photoshop and AI Image Generation Tools, Figma

Primary Marketplace: Amazon

Secondary Marketplace Support: Wayfair, Walmart, and other eCommerce platforms



Start Date: ASAP / Immediate Hiring



What We Are Looking For



Beyond technical skills, we are looking for someone who:

-Has strong experience designing Amazon Listing Images, A+ Content, and Amazon Brand Store creatives.

-Is highly skilled in AI Image Generation and Manipulation, not just basic AI prompting.

-Can create realistic lifestyle images, product scenes, and professional product compositions using AI.

-Has an excellent eye for product details, lighting, shadows, proportions, and visual consistency.

-Understands how product images influence customer buying decisions and conversions.

-Takes ownership of assigned tasks and can work independently with minimal supervision.

-Can manage multiple design requests while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

-Pays close attention to product accuracy and marketplace image guidelines.

-Is flexible and willing to support creative requirements for other eCommerce platforms when needed.

-Understands that Marketplace Operations supports multiple platforms, even though Amazon is the primary focus.

-Is comfortable receiving feedback, making revisions, and collaborating with a remote team.

-Can reliably work during US business hours on a graveyard schedule. (Because if you will just try, don't apply, this won't work for you).



Key Responsibilities



Amazon Listing Images

-Design high-quality Amazon product listing images, including main images, infographics, lifestyle images, and product feature graphics.

-Create visually appealing product infographics highlighting key features, dimensions, benefits, and use cases.

-Develop realistic lifestyle compositions that improve product presentation and customer engagement.

-Optimize existing listing images to improve visual quality and conversion potential.

-Ensure all product images comply with Amazon's image requirements and brand standards.

-Perform background removal, color correction, photo retouching, and advanced image compositing.



Amazon A+ Content Design

-Design engaging Amazon A+ Content and Enhanced Brand Content (EBC) for different product categories.

-Create product comparison charts, feature highlights, lifestyle layouts, and branded content modules.

-Maintain consistent branding across all A+ Content designs.

-Optimize content layouts for both desktop and mobile viewing.

-Update and improve existing A+ Content based on feedback, product changes, or brand requirements.

-Ensure all designs follow Amazon's content guidelines.



Amazon Brand Store Design

-Create visually appealing Amazon Brand Store banners, graphics, and branded layouts.

-Design creative assets for different Brand Store pages and product categories.

-Maintain consistent branding across Amazon Brand Store designs.

-Update existing Brand Store creatives for product launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand refreshes.

-Ensure Brand Store graphics follow Amazon's design specifications and brand requirements.



AI Image Generation and Manipulation

-Use AI-powered tools to generate, enhance, and manipulate product images for eCommerce.

-Create realistic product lifestyle scenes, backgrounds, and visual compositions using AI.

-Perform advanced AI-assisted image editing, including background replacement, object manipulation, lighting adjustments, and image enhancement.

-Combine AI-generated elements with actual product photos to create professional and realistic marketing visuals.

-Ensure AI-generated images accurately represent the actual product, including its shape, proportions, colors, and features.

-Correct AI-generated errors, distortions, unrealistic details, and visual inconsistencies.

-Use AI tools to improve design efficiency without sacrificing image quality or product accuracy.



Cross-Platform Marketplace Creative Support



-As part of the Marketplace Operations Team, you will occasionally provide creative support for Wayfair, Walmart, and other eCommerce platforms.

-Responsibilities may include:

-Resize, reformat, or adjust existing Amazon product images to meet Wayfair, Walmart, or other marketplace image requirements.

-Reuse and adapt approved Amazon creative assets for other eCommerce platforms.

-Make minor image revisions, background adjustments, or formatting changes based on marketplace requirements.

-Ensure product images remain consistent across different marketplace listings.

-Assist the Marketplace Operations Team with occasional creative requests related to other platforms.

-Follow platform-specific image requirements when preparing or modifying creative assets.



Important: The majority of your design work will remain focused on Amazon. However, occasional creative support for Wayfair, Walmart, and other marketplaces is an expected part of this position and not considered outside the role's responsibilities.



-Product Image Editing and Optimization

-Perform professional product photo editing and retouching using Adobe Photoshop.

-Improve product lighting, shadows, textures, colors, and overall visual presentation.

-Create clean, high-resolution product images suitable for Amazon and other supported marketplaces.

-Maintain consistent image quality and branding across multiple products.

-Make design revisions based on feedback and quality assurance reviews.

-Creative Collaboration and Task Management

-Work closely with the Marketplace Operations and creative teams to complete assigned projects.

-Manage multiple design tasks and meet deadlines.

-Organize design files and maintain proper asset documentation.

-Follow project instructions, brand guidelines, and quality standards.

-Communicate progress, concerns, and project updates clearly.



Support other marketplace-related creative projects when needed, within the scope of graphic design and creative asset production.



Tools and Platform

-Primary Design Tools:

-Adobe Photoshop (Required)

-Adobe Illustrator (Advantage)





Applicants do not need to master every AI platform listed, but must demonstrate strong practical experience using AI for realistic product image creation and manipulation.



Marketplace Knowledge:

-Amazon Listing Image Requirements

-Amazon A+ Content Guidelines

-Amazon Brand Store Design Requirements

-Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central is an advantage.

-Basic familiarity with Wayfair, Walmart, or other marketplace image requirements is an advantage.

Qualifications

-At least 2 years of professional experience in Amazon Graphic Design or eCommerce Product Design.

-Proven experience designing Amazon Listing Images, A+ Content, and preferably Amazon Brand Store creatives.

-Strong AI Image Generation and Manipulation skills are required.

title: Procurement Analyst
description:
Engagement: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, Remote

Pay rate: $6/hr



About the role:

You run the day-to-day procurement operations: supporting vendor and contract negotiations, managing vendors and spend, coordinating supplier and service logistics, and operating the procure-to-pay (iBuy) workflow. The goal is to take the operational and administrative layer off the Director so that strategic sourcing and final award decisions are all that remain at the leadership level. The role is positioned to grow into deeper sourcing and analysis over time. 



Responsibilities:

Support vendor and contract negotiations: prepare comparisons, track redlines, and maintain a renewal calendar so no contract lapses. 

Vendor management: onboarding, performance tracking, and serving as the point of contact for routine vendor issues. 

Spend management: operate and monitor the procure-to-pay (iBuy) platform; create and match purchase orders and invoices; reconcile invoices and leases. 

Supplier and service logistics: coordinate orders, deliveries, and service scheduling. 

Maintain procurement records and spend reporting. 



Required qualifications:

2+ years in procurement, purchasing, accounts payable, or vendor management. 

Strong spreadsheet skills and experience with a procure-to-pay or ERP system, including PO / invoice matching and reconciliation. 

Detail-oriented and organized, with clear written English and professional vendor communication. 



Nice to have:

Experience with contract administration or sourcing analysis. 

Familiarity with a dedicated procure-to-pay platform. 



Environment & tools:

iBuy (procure-to-pay), spreadsheets, and standard procurement / reporting tools. 



What success looks like in 90 days:

PO and invoice processing and reconciliation fully handed off. 

A renewal calendar in place with nothing lapsing. 

Spend reporting running on a regular cadence. 



Notes:

Strategic sourcing and final award decisions remain with the Director. This role owns the negotiations support, vendor and spend management, and logistics workload day to day.

title: Offshore Senior Tax Accountant
description:
Position Details 



Reports To: Senior Production Manager 

Classification: Full-Time, Exempt  

Client-Facing Role: No  

Supervisory Responsibilities: None  

Salary Ranges: $40,000 to $50,000 USD per year 



Position Summary 

The Offshore Senior Tax Accountant supports the firm's production team by preparing tax returns, bookkeeping, payroll, and accounting engagements while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, efficiency, and confidentiality. This role works under the direction of the Senior Production Manager and does not communicate directly with clients. 



 



Key responsibilities include: 

- Prepare individual and business tax returns in accordance with firm procedures and IRS regulations. 

- Complete bookkeeping, payroll, and accounting-related engagements as assigned. 

- Maintain accurate workpapers, documentation, and engagement records. 

- Research tax questions using government resources, firm procedures, and internal guidance. 

- Continuously develop technical tax knowledge and participate in ongoing training. 



Core Responsibilities 

Tax Preparation & Accounting 

- Prepare US tax returns, 1040, 1120s, 1065, 990’s, and other US tax returns assigned by the Senior Production Manager. 

- Complete bookkeeping, payroll, and accounting engagements. 

- Enter, reconcile, and analyze financial information. 

- Prepare supporting schedules and workpapers. 

- Maintain client confidentiality regarding all financial information and tax documents. 



Tax Research & Technical Support 

- Research tax issues using IRS publications, government websites, and approved professional resources. 

- Apply current tax laws and firm procedures to assigned engagements. 

- Escalate complex tax questions to the Senior Production Manager or reviewer. 

- Stay current on tax law changes through continuing education and firm training. 



Quality & Production 

- Perform a thorough self-review before submitting work for review. 

- Follow firm checklists, procedures, and documentation standards. 

- Correct review comments promptly and accurately. 

- Complete assigned work within established deadlines. 



Workflow & Team Collaboration 

- Update engagement statuses in firm software. 

- Communicate workload concerns to the Senior Production Manager. 

- Participate in daily production huddles and required team meetings. 

- Collaborate with other production team members to ensure timely completion of engagements. 



Systems & Documentation 

- Maintain accurate and organized electronic workpapers, tax files, and supporting documentation. 

- Update engagement statuses and task progress in TaxDome and other firm systems. 

- Utilize Lacerte, QuickBooks Online, TaxDome, and other approved software to complete assigned work. 

- Document questions, assumptions, and engagement notes for reviewers and production leadership. 

- Follow firm document retention, confidentiality, and data security policies. 

- Ensure all assigned engagements include complete and accurate supporting documentation prior to submission for review. 



Professional Development 

- Complete continuing education requirements. 

- Expand technical knowledge of tax preparation, bookkeeping, and payroll. 

- Learn firm software and production processes. 

- Participate in training and professional development opportunities. 



What This Role Does NOT Do 

- Does not communicate directly with clients unless specifically authorized by direct supervisor. 

- Does not conduct client meetings or Zoom calls. 

- Does not provide tax advice or tax planning directly to clients. 

- Does not prepare or deliver tax plans. 

- Does not participate in sales consultations or prospective client meetings. 

- Does not supervise employees or assign work. 

- Does not independently review or approve completed tax returns. 

- Does not independently create or implement firm-wide policies or procedures. 

- Does not make owner-level business or financial decisions. 



Required Qualifications 

- 5+ years US individual (form 1040) and business (1120s & 1065) US tax preparation. 

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. 

- Ability to interpret and apply US tax laws and regulations. 

- Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment. 

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and willingness to learn firm software. 



Preferred Qualifications 

- CPA preferred 

- Experience with 990’s US tax preparation. 

- Experience with Lacerte, TaxDome, and QuickBooks Online. 

- Experience in a public accounting or tax firm. 

- Experience preparing individual and business tax returns. 

- Knowledge of tax issues affecting real estate investors.

title: Paid Ads Manager
description:
Paid Ads Manager / Agency Manager



Position Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and results-driven Paid Ads Manager / Agency Manager to oversee the law firm’s paid digital advertising initiatives and manage relationships with external advertising agencies. This role is responsible for monitoring campaign performance, evaluating key performance indicators (KPIs), ensuring compliance with legal advertising standards, and identifying opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness and return on investment (ROI).



The ideal candidate has a strong background in paid digital advertising, agency management, performance analysis, and strategic marketing, with the ability to align advertising initiatives with the firm’s business objectives and growth targets.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Agency Management and Oversight



Oversee and manage external advertising agencies responsible for campaigns across Google Ads,
/Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant platforms.



Conduct regular performance reviews, progress meetings, and strategic planning sessions with agency partners.



Establish clear expectations, performance benchmarks, and accountability measures for advertising agencies.



Ensure agencies have the necessary resources, creative assets, brand guidelines, and business information to execute 

campaigns effectively.



Monitor agency deliverables and ensure alignment with the firm’s marketing objectives and timelines.



2. Campaign Performance Monitoring and Reporting



Monitor, analyze, and evaluate paid advertising performance across all active campaigns and platforms.



Track and assess key performance indicators (KPIs), including:

Cost per Lead (CPL)

Cost per Opportunity (CPO)

Cost per Deal (CPD)



Return on Investment (ROI) and other relevant performance metrics.



Evaluate campaign effectiveness against established targets, budgets, and performance benchmarks.



Identify performance trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for optimization.



Prepare accurate performance reports and present actionable insights and recommendations to the Director of Marketing.



Ensure campaign reporting provides clear visibility into lead quality, conversion performance, and advertising spend.



3. Advertising Creative Review and Compliance



Review and approve advertising copy, creative assets, landing pages, and other campaign materials before launch.



Ensure all advertising materials comply with applicable legal advertising rules, professional ethics requirements, brand guidelines, and internal marketing protocols.



Coordinate with legal, compliance, and marketing teams to address potential regulatory or ethical concerns.



Verify that campaign messaging is accurate, consistent, and appropriate for the firm’s legal services.



Maintain quality control across advertising campaigns to minimize compliance risks and protect the firm’s reputation.



4. Strategic Planning and Campaign Optimization



Provide data-driven insights and strategic recommendations to improve campaign performance, lead quality, and ROI.



Collaborate with advertising agencies and internal marketing stakeholders to identify and implement optimization 

opportunities.



Evaluate campaign strategies, audience targeting, advertising budgets, and creative approaches to support business growth.



Stay informed about advertising platform updates, digital marketing trends, industry best practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.



Contribute to the development and execution of the firm’s overall marketing strategy.



Recommend improvements to advertising processes, reporting systems, and agency management practices.



Qualifications and Requirements



Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or a related field.



At least 4 years of experience managing paid digital advertising campaigns.



Demonstrated experience overseeing advertising agencies, external marketing partners, or campaign management teams.



Strong understanding of digital advertising platforms, including Google Ads,
/Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.



Experience analyzing campaign performance using KPIs such as CPL, CPO, CPD, conversion rates, and ROI.



Proficiency in performance reporting, data analysis, and translating campaign results into actionable recommendations.



Knowledge of advertising compliance requirements and marketing best practices; experience in law firms or professional services is preferred.



Excellent communication, organizational, analytical, and project management skills.



Ability to manage multiple campaigns, agency relationships, and priorities simultaneously.



Strong attention to detail and a proactive, results-oriented approach to problem-solving.



The ability to work independently on a part-time schedule and to keep firm turnaround times for ad reviews. 



Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience in legal marketing, law firm advertising, or professional services marketing.



A Google Ads certification.



Experience managing advertising budgets and evaluating agency performance against business objectives.



Familiarity with marketing analytics, conversion tracking, CRM systems, and lead attribution.



Demonstrated ability to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and marketing ROI through data-driven decision-making.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Company: Veterans Educating Veterans

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Schedule: 40 hours per week



Position Summary

Veterans Educating Veterans is seeking an experienced and highly trustworthy Finance Manager to oversee the company’s financial operations.

This role will also be responsible for maintaining the financial records of a separate affiliated trust entity. The Finance Manager must keep both entities’ books, bank accounts, transactions, reports, and supporting documentation accurate, complete, and properly separated.

The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, proactive, and capable of independently managing financial reporting, budgeting, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll coordination, reconciliations, collections, cash flow, and internal controls.



Key Responsibilities



1. Financial Management and Reporting

Prepare accurate weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

Monitor revenue, operating expenses, profitability, cash flow, and overall financial performance.

Develop and maintain budgets, financial forecasts, and budget-versus-actual reports.

Identify financial discrepancies, potential risks, unnecessary expenditures, and cost-saving opportunities.

Provide timely financial updates, analyses, and actionable recommendations to the CEO.

Ensure financial transactions are properly recorded, categorized, and supported by documentation.



2. Accounts Receivable and Collections

Oversee client invoicing, payment arrangements, recurring payments, and collection activities.

Monitor outstanding balances, overdue accounts, failed payments, chargebacks, refunds, and payment disputes.

Reconcile client payments across banking platforms, payment processors, accounting systems, and internal records.

Maintain accurate accounts receivable aging reports and collection records.

Identify collection issues and recommend strategies to improve payment recovery and cash flow.



3. Accounts Payable and Expense Management

Review and process vendor invoices, reimbursements, subscriptions, and operational expenses.

Verify that all payments are accurate, properly documented, and approved by authorized personnel.

Implement safeguards against duplicate, incorrect, or unauthorized payments.

Reconcile vendor statements, bank accounts, credit cards, and payment platforms.

Monitor recurring expenses and identify opportunities for operational cost reductions.



4. Payroll and Contractor Payment Coordination

Coordinate the timely and accurate processing of payroll and independent contractor payments.

Verify compensation rates, hours worked, bonuses, deductions, reimbursements, and payroll adjustments.

Collaborate with Human Resources regarding onboarding, terminations, leave records, compensation changes, and final payments.

Maintain accurate, organized, and confidential payroll and contractor payment records.

Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies in coordination with authorized personnel.



5. Trust Entity Financial Management

Maintain complete and separate accounting records for the affiliated trust entity.

Accurately record and categorize trust income, expenditures, contributions, transfers, assets, and distributions.

Reconcile trust-related bank accounts, investment accounts, and applicable payment platforms.

Prepare independent financial statements and financial reports for the trust entity.

Maintain organized records relating to trustees, beneficiaries, vendors, assets, and distributions, as applicable.

Verify that trust-related transactions are properly authorized and consistent with applicable trust documents and requirements.

Coordinate with authorized trustees, accountants, tax professionals, attorneys, financial institutions, and other relevant parties.

Organize financial documentation required for tax preparation, audits, legal reviews, and trust accounting.

Immediately escalate suspicious transactions, missing documentation, unauthorized activities, or potential misuse of funds.



6. Financial Controls and Entity Separation

Maintain strictly separate financial records, accounts, reports, and documentation for VEV and the affiliated trust entity.

Prevent improper commingling of funds or unauthorized transfers between entities.

Ensure that expenses and payments are processed through the appropriate entity accounts.

Properly record and document all authorized inter-entity transactions.

Obtain written approval from designated authorities before processing transfers, refunds, distributions, or exceptional payments.

Maintain complete and traceable audit trails for material financial transactions.

Protect confidential company, client, employee, contractor, trustee, and beneficiary information.



7. Financial Systems and Process Improvement

Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records using Zoho Books and other approved accounting systems.

Evaluate and improve financial reporting, reconciliation, payment approval, and recordkeeping procedures.

Develop, document, and maintain finance-related Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency without compromising internal controls.

Provide financial process guidance and training to relevant team members.

Ensure consistency, accuracy, and accountability across financial workflows.



8. Leadership and Cross-Department Coordination

Supervise finance and bookkeeping personnel, when applicable.

Delegate responsibilities, review completed work, and ensure deadlines are consistently met.

Collaborate with Human Resources, Operations, Client Services, and executive leadership.

Communicate financial concerns proactively and present practical recommendations.

Support financial planning and other finance-related initiatives assigned by the CEO.



Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in accounting, finance, or financial operations.

At least two (2) years of supervisory or financial management experience.

Strong knowledge of financial reporting, budgeting, cash-flow management, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll coordination, and account reconciliation.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

Experience using Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero, or comparable accounting software.

Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate financial records for multiple entities while ensuring proper separation.

Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.

High standards of integrity, discretion, confidentiality, and professional accountability.

Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple responsibilities, and meet reporting deadlines.

Reliable internet connectivity and a suitable professional remote working environment.



Preferred Qualifications

- Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), or equivalent professional qualification.

- Hands-on experience with Zoho Books, Zoho CRM, or Zoho Analytics.

- Previous experience managing financial operations for a U.S.-based company.

- Familiarity with trust accounting, affiliated organizations, or multi-entity financial management.

- Experience coordinating payroll and payments for international contractors or remote teams.

- Experience developing financial SOPs, strengthening internal controls, and improving accounting workflows.



Performance Expectations



The Finance Manager's performance will be evaluated based on:

- Accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of financial reports.

- Consistent completion of account reconciliations.

- Accuracy and timely coordination of payroll and vendor payments.

- Effectiveness of accounts receivable management and collection efforts.

- Reliability of budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow monitoring.

- Proper separation and accounting of VEV and affiliated trust finances.

- Compliance with internal financial controls and approval procedures.

- Quality and organization of financial documentation.

- Proactive identification and resolution of financial discrepancies.

- Professional responsiveness, reliability, confidentiality, and adherence to deadlines.



Compensation and Employment Terms

This is a full-time, remote position with a fixed, non-negotiable salary.

The agreed compensation covers the complete scope of responsibilities associated with both Veterans Educating Veterans and its affiliated trust entity.



Applicants are expected to review and accept the stated compensation and responsibilities before proceeding with the recruitment process.



Confidentiality, Financial Authority, and Accountability

The Finance Manager will have access to highly sensitive financial information, including company banking records, payroll details, client payment information, trust records, and confidential trustee and beneficiary information.



Strict confidentiality and adherence to established financial controls are mandatory.



The Finance Manager is not authorized to independently:

- Transfer or distribute company or trust funds without appropriate approval.

- Process unauthorized payments or financial adjustments.

- Modify employee or contractor compensation without authorization.

- Open or close financial accounts.

- Make investment decisions on behalf of either entity.

- Disclose confidential financial or personal information to unauthorized individuals.



Suspected fraud, misuse of funds, unauthorized disclosures, or serious violations of established financial procedures will be investigated and may result in termination of the working relationship and legal action, where warranted and permitted by applicable law.



Equal Opportunity Statement



Veterans Educating Veterans is committed to providing equal opportunities to qualified applicants. Recruitment and selection decisions are based on relevant qualifications, professional experience, demonstrated competence, integrity, and organizational requirements, without unlawful discrimination.



Join Veterans Educating Veterans



We are looking for a dependable and results-driven Finance Manager who can take ownership of financial operations, maintain strong internal controls, and support the organization's continued growth through accurate reporting, financial discipline, and responsible management of resources.

title: Property Accountant
description:
Who We Are



Reside Management is a progressive residential property management company based in Vancouver, B.C. We manage single-unit and multi-family properties across the Lower Mainland and are committed to accurate reporting, responsive service, strong systems, and continuous improvement.



We are expanding our accounting support team and are looking for an experienced Virtual Accounting Assistant who wants a stable, long-term role and can contribute with accuracy from day one.



About the Role



This is a hands-on accounting position supporting the day-to-day and month-end financial operations of a residential property management portfolio. You will work closely with management, property managers, and the accounting team to maintain complete and accurate records in Buildium, QuickBooks, Google Sheets, and Microsoft Excel.



The successful candidate understands property management accounting, catches discrepancies before they become problems, follows written procedures carefully, and asks clear questions when information is incomplete.



Key Responsibilities



1. Maintain accurate tenant, owner, property, vendor, and general ledger records in Buildium.

2. Record and review rent, deposits, management fees, owner contributions, vendor charges, reimbursements, and other property transactions.

3. Process accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoice review, coding, approval tracking, posting, and payment preparation.

4. Complete bank, credit card, trust, operating, and clearing-account reconciliations and promptly investigate discrepancies.

5. Review tenant ledgers, rent rolls, outstanding balances, unapplied funds, security deposits, and recurring charges for accuracy.

6. Prepare and review owner statements, monthly financial reports, supporting schedules, and month-end workpapers.

7. Maintain accurate records in QuickBooks Online and ensure entries agree with approved source documents and supporting systems.

8. Use Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel to reconcile data, track exceptions, analyze variances, and prepare clear management reports.

9. Support Canadian and B.C. property management accounting processes, including GST-related records and trust-account documentation, under the direction of authorized team members.

10. Organize invoices, receipts, statements, approvals, and audit support in accordance with the company filing system.

11. Identify missing documents, unusual balances, duplicate entries, and process gaps; escalate issues with a clear explanation and proposed next step.

12. Follow established procedures, complete assigned work by deadline, and communicate progress or blockers promptly.



Required Experience and Qualifications



- Property management accounting: Minimum three years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience in residential property management or real estate.



- Pacific Standard Time schedule: At least two years in a prior position consistently working Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Standard Time is required.



- Buildium: Minimum two years of regular, hands-on experience. You must be able to navigate accounting workflows confidently and use the platform with limited training.



- QuickBooks: Strong working experience with QuickBooks Online, including transaction entry, coding, reconciliations, and financial reporting.



- Spreadsheets: Strong Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, filters, sorting, lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliation schedules.



- Accounting knowledge: Practical understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger coding, bank reconciliations, tenant ledgers, deposits, owner statements, and month-end close.



- Accuracy and judgment: Excellent numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to recognize when information does not reconcile.



- Communication: Strong written and spoken English, active listening skills, and the ability to follow instructions and document work clearly.



- Work style: Reliable, organized, coachable, willing to learn, and able to manage priorities independently while remaining accountable to the team.



- Remote setup: A quiet professional workspace, reliable high-speed internet, a dependable computer, and a practical backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



- Confidentiality: Demonstrated discretion when handling banking information, owner statements, tenant records, and other confidential financial information.



What We Offer



- A stable, full-time, long-term remote position with a consistent schedule.

- The opportunity to work with an established Canadian property management company.

- Structured training, documented processes, and support from the accounting and operations teams.

- Room to take on greater responsibility as your accuracy, reliability, and knowledge of the portfolio grow.

- A collaborative, improvement-focused environment that values integrity, accountability, dependability, and initiative.



Application Process



Please submit:

- Your current resume.

- A short cover letter describing your property management accounting experience in Canada and your experience using Buildium and QuickBooks Online.

title: Caller + Social Media Specialist — Speed-to-Lead ($6/hr + 3% Commission Draw + Bonuses)
description:
About us: We run several U.S. businesses from Tennessee — a wedding venue, furnished housing for veterans and work crews, and a healing practice. We are about to run ads, and we are hiring because we cannot miss a single lead.



The job — calls:

- Answer inbound calls and respond to new leads FAST — Zola inquiries, Google leads, website leads, and phone calls. New leads are contacted within minutes, not hours.

- Pick up the phone for ALL of our businesses — wedding couples, caseworkers calling about veteran housing, housing guests, healing clients. Whoever calls gets a warm, professional human.

- Make outbound follow-up calls to leads who inquired but have not booked yet.



The job — social media:

- Manage our social media accounts daily: post scheduled content, reply to messages and comments on our pages and in our groups, and keep every conversation answered the same day.

- Flag hot leads from social media to the pipeline immediately — no inquiry sits unanswered.



The job — systems:

- Log every call, message, and lead in our CRM (GoHighLevel) the same day, and keep the pipelines current.



Pay — please read carefully:

- $6/hour starting rate.

- 3% commission on every booking YOU close — paid as a DRAW. What is a draw? A draw is an advance we pay you against the commissions you will earn. Instead of waiting until a booking is fully paid, you receive commission money up front as a draw; as your closed bookings pay in, your 3% commissions are applied against the draw you already received. Once your earned commissions pass the draw, you keep earning 3% on top. Reliable closers earn well above the hourly rate.

- $25/month bonus for being on time to every meeting and every shift, every month.

- $30/month health insurance stipend after your first 90 days.



Requirements:

- Real inbound AND outbound calling experience (sales, appointment setting, or lead follow-up).

- Social media management experience for a business (posting, replying, community management).

- Clear, warm, professional spoken AND written English — you will be the first voice of our businesses.

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset.

- Available during U.S. Central Time business hours, and dependable — our leads cannot wait.

- Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM is a plus.



How to apply — answer ALL of these questions and send your voice recording. Applications missing any step are not reviewed:

1. Subject line: PORTFOLIO READY — CALLER

2. A Vocaroo voice recording (60–90 seconds): introduce yourself and tell us about the toughest call you ever turned into a booking.

3. How many calls per day have you handled, inbound and outbound? For what kinds of businesses?

4. Have you managed social media accounts for a business? Which platforms, and what exactly did you do?

5. What CRM or tools have you used?

6. Are you available during U.S. Central Time business hours on every scheduled day? Answer yes or no, and give your hours.



We are hiring now. If you are fast, warm, organized, and never let a lead sit, we want to hear your voice.

title: Graphic Designer — Ecommerce Ads & Brand (UK pet brand, long-term)
description:
We're Lucy & Lola, a UK brand that embroiders people's pets onto jumpers, hoodies, cushions and bags from a photo they send us. We were on Dragons' Den last year, we have thousands of five-star reviews, and we're growing fast. We're small, friendly and we move quickly.



We're looking for one designer to own everything visual apart from
.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Design static ads for Meta — around 8-12 new ones a week, plus versions of the ads that are already winning

Come up with your own ad concepts, not just execute briefs. You'll have our customer reviews, our product photography and our brand to work from, and we want your ideas

Website graphics: banners, product page assets, landing pages, collection images

Print: flyers and graphics for trade shows, signage, packaging inserts

Brand bits: templates, organic social graphics, whatever comes up

Our media buying agency briefs the ad iterations based on what's performing. The fresh thinking comes from you and from us.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



3+ years designing for ecommerce or in an agency, with ad creative in your portfolio

Figma or Adobe Creative Suite. Canva is fine for speed, but we want to see real design skill underneath

You understand why an ad works, not just how to lay one out. You'll be asked to explain your thinking

Strong written English and a good eye for typography

Reliable internet. You can work whatever hours suit you — we care about the work, not when you're online — as long as you're contactable during your day and can join one call a week

ABOUT AI

We use AI tools day to day and have no problem with them. What we don't want is AI-generated imagery or AI-assembled layouts — our customers notice and they don't like it. Everything you make should be built from our photography and real design work, and we'll ask to see your source files.



THE DEAL



Full time, 40 hours a week

$1,000-$1,400 per month depending on experience and portfolio

Three-month contract to start, with the option to go permanent for the right person. We'd like this to be a long-term relationship

Paid monthly in USD

HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line: "Static ads — [name a dog breed you like]"



In your application, send us:



A link to your portfolio, with at least three ecommerce or social ad examples

Go and look at our Instagram 
 and pick one of our recent ads. Tell us in a few sentences what you'd change about it and why

The tools you use day to day

Your expected monthly rate

The hours you usually work, and a time that would suit you for a weekly call

Applications without the subject line or without point 2 won't be read. Shortlisted applicants will be paid for a short test brief before we make an offer.

title: SMALL ENGINE MECHANIC – REMOTE TECHNICAL SUPPORT
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced small engine mechanic based in the Philippines to provide remote technical support to North American customers.



This position requires substantial professional repair experience, advanced diagnostic ability, excellent spoken and written English, and strong computer skills. The successful candidate must be able to explain technical issues clearly, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple customer cases accurately and professionally.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Diagnose complex engine problems remotely through phone calls, chat, photographs, and video.



• Guide customers through diagnostic checks, testing, and repairs using clear, straightforward English.



• Identify the correct replacement parts using equipment model, type, code, and serial numbers.



• Read and interpret service manuals, wiring diagrams, and illustrated parts diagrams.



• Diagnose faults involving fuel delivery, ignition, compression, electrical systems, governors, valvetrains, charging systems, and internal engine components.



• Maintain accurate records of customer conversations, diagnostic findings, troubleshooting steps, and recommendations.



• Communicate patiently and professionally with customers who have varying levels of mechanical knowledge.



• Manage multiple customer cases, prioritize outstanding issues, and follow through without compromising accuracy or service quality.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Five or more years of professional, hands-on experience diagnosing and repairing small engines.



• Advanced knowledge of 2-stroke and 4-stroke engines, including their operation, maintenance, and repair.



• Excellent spoken English, with clear pronunciation and a professional telephone manner.



• Excellent written English, including strong grammar, spelling, and reading comprehension.



• Ability to explain technical information and repair instructions clearly and naturally to North American customers.



• Strong computer proficiency, including efficient typing,
 and chat communication, online research, and navigation between multiple applications.



• A reliable computer, quality headset, high-speed internet, a backup internet connection, and a quiet workspace suitable for customer calls.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



• Ten or more years of professional small engine repair experience.



• Previous experience as a lead technician, shop foreman, service manager, technical adviser, or instructor.



• Experience diagnosing and repairing engines or equipment from Briggs & Stratton, Honda, Kohler, Kawasaki, Stihl, Husqvarna, Yamaha, Generac, Tecumseh, or comparable manufacturers.



• Familiarity with equipment commonly used in North America and the terminology customers use to describe it.



• Experience using electronic parts catalogs, service databases, ticketing systems, or customer management software.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



• Your résumé outlining your professional mechanical experience.



• A two-minute, unedited introduction in English, submitted as a video or voice recording.



• A brief written summary of your mechanical experience, including the engines, equipment, and types of repairs you have worked on.



• A written response to this diagnostic scenario: An engine cranks but will not start. Explain the steps you would take to identify the cause and why.



• Details of your internet speed, backup internet connection, and available working hours, including your time zone.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates will complete:



• A live interview conducted in English.



• A written English and customer service assessment.



• A practical small engine diagnostic interview.



• A computer proficiency and online research assessment.



Only applicants who meet all required qualifications will be considered.

description:

Outreach

4. AI Tool Integration: Active, practical experience integrating AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney) into design and creative workflows.

5. Swift Communication & Leadership: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills; highly responsive, proactive, and comfortable taking charge of fast-moving projects.

6. Schedule & Location: Must be based in the Philippines and available to work 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PST.



What We Look For

1. Swift & Proactive Communicator: Keeps the team aligned, responds quickly, and flags blockers before they become issues.

2. Autonomous Leader: Takes complete ownership, steps up to lead, and drives results from concept to launch.

3. Strategic Thinker & Builder: Connects creative output directly to business goals and builds scalable systems to make future production smoother.

title: Part-Time Virtual Receptionist & Student Support | $7.50 USD/hour | 21 hours/week
description:
Skyline School is a North Carolina school serving real estate brokers and general contractors. We’re hiring a Philippines-based receptionist to be the first person students reach when they call, text, or open a chat on our website.



On a typical shift, you might help a broker find the link to a class that starts in ten minutes, answer a prospective student’s text about a course, and pick up a website chat from someone looking for their certificate. We’re looking for someone who enjoys talking with people, writes clear and friendly replies, and follows through until the student knows what to do next.



What you’ll do: 

- Cover incoming phone calls, text messages, and website chats throughout your shift. When a call comes in while you’re helping someone by chat, you’ll need to acknowledge the waiting student, take the call, and pick up the conversation where you left off.

- Help students find the right course, register, access their classes, and locate their completion certificates.

- Use Skyline’s website and school resources to give accurate answers. When a question needs another team member, explain the next step to the student and pass along enough detail that they won’t have to start over.



Pay and schedule

$7.50 USD per hour for 21 guaranteed hours each week. You’ll occasionally have the option to pick up additional paid hours when another team member calls out. These extra shifts are optional.



U.S. Eastern Time (North Carolina)

Monday, Wednesday, Friday: 12 noon to 5:00 PM

Tuesday, Thursday: 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM



Philippine time during U.S. standard time

Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday: 1:00 AM to 6:00 AM

Wednesday, Friday: 3:00 AM to 6:00 AM



Philippine time during U.S. daylight saving time

Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday: 12 midnight to 5:00 AM

Wednesday, Friday: 2:00 AM to 5:00 AM



What we’re looking for

You should be comfortable speaking English on the phone and writing short, natural replies to students. Experience answering customer calls and managing live chat or text conversations is especially helpful. You’ll need a reliable internet connection, a computer, a clear headset, and a quiet place to take calls. You can learn our courses on the job. What matters from day one is that you listen carefully, know how to look something up, and keep track of who’s waiting for a reply.

How to apply

Please include the following in your application or your first message on OnlineJobs.ph:

1. Briefly tell us about your experience helping customers by phone, chat, or text.



2. Confirm that you can consistently work all five shifts, including Saturday morning in the Philippines, and that the schedule works for you when U.S. clocks change.



3. Review Skyline School’s websites (
 and 
) and answer the three student texts below. Write the exact reply you would send to each student, in your own words. One to three sentences per reply is plenty. Under each answer, paste the link to the Skyline page you used.



Student text 1

“Hi! I’m signing up for a self-paced real estate CE elective on May 25. Do I get the full 30 days? What’s the last day I can finish?”



Student text 2

“I finished my CE class last week and need a copy of my certificate. I’ve never used your certificate portal before. Where do I go, and how do I sign in the first time?”



Student text 3

“I’m signing up for a contractor CE class. I have my company’s license number handy. Is that the number you need? If not, where do I find the right one?”



4. Include a short voice recording with your application or first message. Imagine you’ve just answered the phone at Skyline School. For each of the two calls below, record what you would actually say to the student. You can review our website first. We’d like to hear how you explain things in your own words.



Call 1: “Hi, my Zoom class starts in ten minutes and I can’t find the link. I know I paid for it, but I’ve searched my
 twice. Can you help me get in?”



Call 2: “Hi! I’m a real estate broker and I need an elective. My work schedule changes every week, and sometimes I only have an hour free in the evening. Do you have something I could take? How would it work?”



One audio recording covering both calls is perfect. Aim for about 30–45 seconds per answer. You can attach an audio file or share a link we can open without signing in. A voice memo from your phone is fine. No video is needed.



We read these replies first because they give us a feel for how you’d help a Skyline student. Thanks for taking the time to apply!

title: Social Media Manager for Wedding Photographer (Part Time)
description:
Hiring: Social Media Manager for Wedding Photography Business



Job Type: Freelance / Part Time

Location: Remote

Industry: Wedding & Lifestyle Photography

Starting Pay: CAD $40 to $50 per week



Hi there!



I'm a professional wedding and lifestyle photographer based in Vancouver, Canada, and I'm looking for a creative and reliable social media manager to help me grow my photography business across Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest.



My photography style is natural, candid, warm, and storytelling focused.



I'm looking for someone who has a really good eye for photography, understands social media trends, and can create beautiful content that matches my brand.



What I'm NOT looking for:



Someone who simply posts pictures to fill up my social media accounts without putting thought into the content.



Someone who uses the same generic templates and captions for every post.



Someone who needs to be reminded constantly about deadlines.



Someone who doesn't pay attention to small details.



Someone who relies entirely on AI generated captions without making them sound natural.



Someone who doesn't take time to understand my photography style and brand.



Someone who struggles with communication or staying organized.



Someone who doesn't have a reliable internet connection.



What I need help with:



Managing my Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest accounts.



Creating and scheduling around 3 posts per week, including carousels and reels.



Posting daily Instagram stories.



Going through full wedding galleries and selecting the strongest images for social media.



Creating beautiful carousel posts that tell a story rather than just posting random pictures.



Finding trending audio and creative reel ideas that work well for wedding photography.



Writing natural, engaging captions that match my brand.



Creating Pinterest pins using my existing photography.



Planning content ahead of time and keeping everything organized.



Researching wedding photography trends and suggesting creative content ideas.



Helping improve engagement and attract potential wedding clients.



Important: I don't expect completely different content for all three platforms.



The same photos, reels, and other content can be reused across Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest, with small adjustments to the format, captions, and presentation to suit each platform.



My main goal is to have a consistent and beautiful social media presence without having to create everything from scratch for each platform.



I will provide access to my wedding galleries, videos, and other content you need.



What I'm looking for:



Having a good creative eye is extremely important to me.



I don't want someone who simply posts pictures. I want someone who can look through a full wedding gallery, understand the emotions and story behind the day, and select the right images to create something beautiful.



If you've worked with a wedding photographer before, or you're currently managing social media for a wedding photographer, that's definitely a big bonus!



Ideally, you should:



Have experience managing Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest.



Understand wedding photography aesthetics and visual storytelling.



Have a strong understanding of reels, carousels, and current trends.



Be comfortable using Canva, CapCut, or similar editing tools.



Have good written English and be able to write natural captions.



Be organized, reliable, and able to meet deadlines.



Be creative and comfortable sharing your own ideas.



Understand how to maintain a consistent brand style.



Have a reliable internet connection.



A little about the position:



This is a freelance, part time position to start.



My starting budget is CAD $40 to $50 per week, depending on experience and the work you can offer.



I'm happy to discuss the workload and expectations to make sure it's fair for both of us.



I'm looking for someone I can work with long term, not just for a few weeks.



I care more about creativity, reliability, communication, and quality of work than how many years of experience you have.



As my business grows, there may be opportunities for more work and responsibilities.



How to apply:



If this sounds like something you'd enjoy doing, I'd love to hear from you!



Please make sure to share your portfolio. I'd really love to see your previous work before moving forward with any applications.



Please include the following:



A short introduction about yourself.



Your portfolio showing your previous social media work.



Links to Instagram, TikTok, or Pinterest accounts you've managed.



Examples of carousel posts, reels, and Pinterest content you've personally created.



Let me know if you've previously worked with a wedding photographer or are currently working with one.



Your weekly rate and what services you can provide within my budget.



What tools you normally use for editing and scheduling content.



A little about how you would approach growing a wedding photography business across these three platforms.



One small request: Please start your application with the words "Wedding Stories" an

inspirational quote that makes you happy :)



Looking forward to finding someone creative to work with!

title: Senior Accountant — QuickBooks & Multi-Entity Accounting
description:
About the role



Vascenda is hiring a Senior Accountant to support the finance team of a U.S. specialty medical practice with three related companies. You'll work directly with the CFO and own the month-end close across all three entities in QuickBooks, from journal entries and reconciliations through draft financial statements. You'll also lead the day-to-day work of transitioning each entity from cash-basis to accrual-basis accounting.



You'll start with documented procedures and live screen-sharing sessions to learn the team's workflows and systems. From there, you'll take ownership of the close calendar, review the work of other team members, and serve as the CFO's go-to person for accounting questions, with the CFO focusing on final review and decisions.



What you'll do



— Own the monthly close for all three entities: manage the close checklist, set deadlines, and deliver accurate, reconciled books on schedule.

— Prepare and review recurring, adjusting, and intercompany journal entries in QuickBooks, ensuring each has clear support and proper approval.

— Own intercompany accounting: reconcile due-to/due-from balances across the three entities, resolve differences, and prepare elimination entries for consolidated reporting.

— Review bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations, and investigate and resolve unusual or aged items before escalating only what needs a CFO decision.

— Record patient revenue, insurance receivables, contractual adjustments, and payroll from practice management and payroll system reports, and analyze trends and variances.

— Build and maintain accrual, prepaid, deferral, and fixed asset schedules, and ensure they tie to the general ledger.

— Prepare draft monthly financial statements for each entity and a consolidated view, with brief explanations of significant variances.

— Lead the cash-to-accrual transition: plan the conversion approach, prepare opening balance adjustments, document assumptions, and record approved entries.

— Strengthen internal controls and accounting procedures, and help train and review the work of junior team members.

— Prepare organized records and schedules for outside tax advisers and auditors, and handle financial, payroll, and practice information with discretion.



What you'll bring



— 5–8 years of hands-on accounting experience, including owning the month-end close and preparing financial statements.

— Advanced QuickBooks experience, including reviewing general ledger activity, managing the chart of accounts, and working across multiple company files.

— Strong command of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, and intercompany transactions and eliminations. You can explain why an entry is needed, how it affects each entity, and how you'd confirm it was recorded correctly.

— Experience reviewing others' work, catching errors, and giving clear feedback.

— Advanced Excel skills, including building reconciliation and accrual schedules.

— Clear written and spoken English, sound judgment, and the confidence to raise issues early and explain them to non-accountants.

— Availability to work [hours] [time zone], with a dependable home-office setup and reliable internet.



Nice to have



— Direct experience leading a cash-to-accrual conversion.

— Experience supporting U.S. businesses with multiple related entities.

— Healthcare, medical practice, or practice management system experience.

— A CPA credential or a degree in accounting.



How to apply



Send your résumé and a short introduction. Tell us which QuickBooks version you've used, which parts of the month-end close you've owned, and how many entities you've managed at once. Give one brief example of an intercompany or accrual entry you prepared or reviewed, and one example of an accounting process you improved. Include your availability in Philippine time and a short video introduction. Our hiring process includes a practical accounting exercise.

title: Street Team Manager: Quezon City & North Metro Manila
description:
Field Sales Manager - Quezon City & North Metro Manila: Uncapped Team Bonuses, PHP 25,000 Guaranteed While You Build



TYPE OF WORK: Full Time

SALARY: $1000 - $2000+

HOURS PER WEEK: 40

LOCATION: On-site in Quezon City and North Metro Manila. Not home based.



JOB OVERVIEW



On-site field management role in Quezon City and North Metro Manila. You run your team on the ground here. Not home based.



You build and run a team of 10 field reps. You recruit them, train them, go out with them, and hold them to their daily numbers. Your reps hand out leaflets, talk to people face to face, and sign up the interested ones on their own phone with a QR code. You are paid on everything your team brings in, with no cap, and a guaranteed PHP 25,000 a month while you are still building the team.



WHY THIS AREA



The densest foot traffic in the country, students and jobseekers everywhere, and everything reachable by one jeepney or the MRT.



WHERE YOUR TEAM WORKS



SM North EDSA and Trinoma, every day of the week

Araneta City in Cubao, plus Farmers Market and the bus terminals around it

Commonwealth Avenue, Novaliches Bayan and the Litex and Fairview markets

Monumento and the Caloocan terminals at rush hour

UP Diliman, Ateneo, PUP branches and the campus areas on enrolment and job-fair days

Barangay events and door to door in Novaliches, Fairview and Project 8 where allowed



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



Recruit your own reps in your area. Job posts, referrals, walk-ins, campus boards, whatever works where you are. Nobody sends you candidates.

Interview and hire them, and take every candidate out in the field for half an hour before you hire them.

Hire in batches of 5 or more so they train together, and keep recruiting even when you are full.

Run the training day yourself, then put new reps out in pairs and ride along with each one in their first week.

Run the morning huddle: yesterday's numbers by rep, today's areas, 15 minutes of practice on the objection of the day.

Ride along every day with whichever rep is furthest behind, and coach on the spot.

Collect every rep's numbers by 8pm, find the one step that is low for each one, and fix that one thing.

Weekly one-to-one with anyone under target, and a spot-check that their sign-ups are real.

Get barangay, HOA or mall permission before your team works an area.

Send one weekly report: numbers per rep, drop-offs, and what you are changing.



PAY



Team bonus: PHP 200 for every approved sign-up any of your reps brings in. No cap.

Monthly team bonus: PHP 80 every month for each person your team signed up who stays active.

Your own sign-ups: if you sign someone up yourself, it pays at the full rep rate of PHP 1,000, plus PHP 550 a month while they stay active.

Guaranteed minimum: PHP 25,000 for the month while you are building your team. You are paid on what your team brings in, and if that comes to less than PHP 25,000 in a month, we top you up to PHP 25,000. If it comes to more, you simply keep it.

The guarantee covers your first 3 months, and applies in any month where you have at least 5 reps working and your team brings in at least 100 approved sign-ups. It is there so building a team does not cost you a month of income, not as a salary for a quiet month.

Transport allowance: PHP 3,000 per month.

Leaflets, ID lanyards and stand materials for your whole team are provided. Neither you nor your reps ever pay for anything. Training is paid.



WHAT YOU CAN EARN IN A MONTH (examples, not a promise)



A full team of 10 reps, each at 10 approved sign-ups a week (400 a month for the team): PHP 80,000 team bonus + PHP 3,000 transport = PHP 83,000

A full team of 10, each at 25 a week (1,000 a month for the team): PHP 200,000 + PHP 3,000 = PHP 203,000

On top of that, the monthly team bonus keeps adding up: 400 people your team signed up who are still active = an extra PHP 32,000 every month.

Anything you sign up yourself pays on top, at the full rep rate.

Once your team is running, the guarantee stops mattering: hitting the KPI pays several times PHP 25,000.



TRACKING



Every rep gets their own QR code and link, and every sign-up is credited automatically. You get a dashboard showing every rep, every sign-up, which ones are approved, which people are active this month, and what you have earned.



TEAM SIZE



You build and run a team of 10 reps. We do not find them for you: recruiting, hiring, training, managing and replacing them is the job. An empty seat is money you are not making.



HOURS



Monday to Friday, about 8 hours a day in the field with your team, daytime, plus some paid weekend events.



REQUIREMENTS



Lives in Quezon City, Caloocan, Valenzuela or nearby, and can move around North Metro Manila daily

Has led a field, promo, direct sales, insurance, collections or door-to-door team before

Can recruit and hire locally without us sending you candidates

Clear spoken English and Filipino or your local language

Comfortable being out in the field with your team every day, not sat in an office

Smartphone with mobile data

Honest, and will let a rep go rather than carry weak numbers
