title: Area Sales Manager - Cavite
description:
Street Team Manager - Manila, Makati, Taguig & Pasay: Uncapped Team Bonuses, PHP 25,000 Guaranteed While You Build



TYPE OF WORK: Full Time

SALARY: $1000 - $2000+

HOURS PER WEEK: 40

LOCATION: On-site in Manila, Makati, Taguig and Pasay. Not home based.



JOB OVERVIEW



On-site field management role in the Metro Manila core. You run your team on the ground here. Not home based.



You build and run a team of 10 field reps. You recruit them, train them, go out with them, and hold them to their daily numbers. Your reps hand out leaflets, talk to people face to face, and sign up the interested ones on their own phone with a QR code. You are paid on everything your team brings in, with no cap, and a guaranteed PHP 25,000 a month while you are still building the team.



WHY THIS AREA



The University Belt, Divisoria and the CBD crowds give your team more conversations per hour than anywhere else in the Philippines.



WHERE YOUR TEAM WORKS



The University Belt on Recto and Morayta: UST, FEU, UE and the hostels around them

Divisoria and Quiapo on market days

Baclaran, EDSA-Taft and the MOA area

Makati CBD and BGC at lunch time and at 6pm

Guadalupe, Ayala and Taft stations at rush hour

PITX and the Pasay terminals for the provincial crowd



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



Recruit your own reps in your area. Job posts, referrals, walk-ins, campus boards, whatever works where you are. Nobody sends you candidates.

Interview and hire them, and take every candidate out in the field for half an hour before you hire them.

Hire in batches of 5 or more so they train together, and keep recruiting even when you are full.

Run the training day yourself, then put new reps out in pairs and ride along with each one in their first week.

Run the morning huddle: yesterday's numbers by rep, today's areas, 15 minutes of practice on the objection of the day.

Ride along every day with whichever rep is furthest behind, and coach on the spot.

Collect every rep's numbers by 8pm, find the one step that is low for each one, and fix that one thing.

Weekly one-to-one with anyone under target, and a spot-check that their sign-ups are real.

Get barangay, HOA or mall permission before your team works an area.

Send one weekly report: numbers per rep, drop-offs, and what you are changing.



PAY



Team bonus: PHP 200 for every approved sign-up any of your reps brings in. No cap.

Monthly team bonus: PHP 80 every month for each person your team signed up who stays active.

Your own sign-ups: if you sign someone up yourself, it pays at the full rep rate of PHP 1,000, plus PHP 550 a month while they stay active.

Guaranteed minimum: PHP 25,000 for the month while you are building your team. You are paid on what your team brings in, and if that comes to less than PHP 25,000 in a month, we top you up to PHP 25,000. If it comes to more, you simply keep it.

The guarantee covers your first 3 months, and applies in any month where you have at least 5 reps working and your team brings in at least 100 approved sign-ups. It is there so building a team does not cost you a month of income, not as a salary for a quiet month.

Transport allowance: PHP 3,000 per month.

Leaflets, ID lanyards and stand materials for your whole team are provided. Neither you nor your reps ever pay for anything. Training is paid.



WHAT YOU CAN EARN IN A MONTH (examples, not a promise)



A full team of 10 reps, each at 10 approved sign-ups a week (400 a month for the team): PHP 80,000 team bonus + PHP 3,000 transport = PHP 83,000

A full team of 10, each at 25 a week (1,000 a month for the team): PHP 200,000 + PHP 3,000 = PHP 203,000

On top of that, the monthly team bonus keeps adding up: 400 people your team signed up who are still active = an extra PHP 32,000 every month.

Anything you sign up yourself pays on top, at the full rep rate.

Once your team is running, the guarantee stops mattering: hitting the KPI pays several times PHP 25,000.



TRACKING



Every rep gets their own QR code and link, and every sign-up is credited automatically. You get a dashboard showing every rep, every sign-up, which ones are approved, which people are active this month, and what you have earned.



TEAM SIZE



You build and run a team of 10 reps. We do not find them for you: recruiting, hiring, training, managing and replacing them is the job. An empty seat is money you are not making.



HOURS



Monday to Friday, about 8 hours a day in the field with your team, daytime, plus some paid weekend events.



REQUIREMENTS



Lives in Manila, Makati, Taguig, Pasay or Mandaluyong, and can move around the core daily

Has led a field, promo, direct sales, insurance, collections or door-to-door team before

Can recruit and hire locally without us sending you candidates

Clear spoken English and Filipino or your local language

Comfortable being out in the field with your team every day, not sat in an office

Smartphone with mobile data

Honest, and will let a rep go rather than carry weak numbers

Wants to be paid on results, not on showing up

Nobody on your team ever promises anyone a fixed income.

title: AI Consultant
description:
Overview

Notion CFO & Advisors is a fractional CFO and accounting advisory firm. We are looking for an AI Consultant to help us apply modern AI tools to improve how our firm operates. This is a hands-on, internal-facing role focused on turning real-world workflows into AI-assisted systems: reducing manual work, improving consistency, and helping our team move faster.

This is not a traditional developer role and it is not a strategy role. It is a building role, for someone who has made AI a core part of how they already work and who is ready to apply that to a real business with real problems to solve. We currently use Claude Co-Work and expect it to be part of the toolkit, but we're open to the right person bringing their own tool judgment and approach.



We are an accounting and advisory firm. The problems you'll work on are practical: faster document intake and data gathering, more consistent review and reporting workflows, smarter tracking of deadlines and open items, and automations that make our accounting, tax, and administrative teams more effective.



What you'll do

• Work directly with team members to understand how work gets done across accounting, tax, and administration

• Turn messy, manual processes into structured, repeatable systems, such as automating document intake, recurring reporting, or first-draft preparation for internal review

• Build outputs like draft summaries, status trackers, checklists, templates, and reusable skills or prompts for the team

• Connect tools and platforms so information flows automatically between systems

• Follow our data-privacy and confidentiality standards when automations touch financial or personnel information, and build in human review checkpoints

• Continuously test and improve, introducing new automations on a regular cadence

This is an ongoing role. The expectation is regular, visible progress, not a one-time build.



What you need

Required

• 2 years of daily, hands-on AI use in a professional context. AI must already be central to how you work, not an occasional tool

• Hands-on experience working with Claude, including Claude Co-Work or similar AI workspace environments

• Strong systems thinking: able to take an ambiguous, real-world process and make it structured and repeatable

• Comfort experimenting without a clear roadmap and iterating quickly based on results

• Clear communication skills; you will work closely with non-technical teammates

• Care with sensitive information and attention to accuracy



Helpful but not required

• Experience with workflow automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or n8n

• Familiarity with tools like QuickBooks, Airtable, or Google Workspace

• Background in accounting, bookkeeping, tax, or professional services



What success looks like

• Time spent on manual, repetitive tasks drops across the accounting, tax, and administrative teams

• Recurring deliverables and internal reports are prepared faster and more consistently

• Key workflows run reliably without requiring constant human intervention

• The team is empowered to maintain and extend automations independently

• New improvements ship on a regular, visible cadence



How to apply

Attach a resume and 1–2 examples of AI or automation work you've built (link to a tool you've created or a screen recording).

title: Customer Service Expert — E-Commerce Support at Scale
description:
We're looking for a customer service specialist who understands one thing clearly:

A good reply doesn't just sound polite. It answers the real question, solves the problem before it grows, and turns a frustrated customer into one who orders again.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy, Spain, UK and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means most customers meet us through an ad, arrive with questions, and write to us in their own language. Support is not a cost center for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of trust, retention, and repeat revenue.

We're looking for someone who can own that inbox across several languages — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us answer fast, absorb volume, and open new markets without the quality dropping.

This role is ideal for someone who understands e-commerce support, multilingual communication, courier problems, refunds and disputes, AI-assisted workflows, and the difference between closing a ticket and keeping a customer.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE HANDLING ---

You'll be working the inbox of a DTC brand running paid traffic, which means:

— "Where is my order": stalled tracking, parcels stuck at a hub, deliveries marked complete but never received

— Pre-purchase questions: people who saw the ad and want to know if it works and if we're real

— Product and skin questions: ingredients, how to use it, what to expect and when, sensitive skin, pregnancy

— Reactions and complaints: rare, serious, handled carefully and escalated properly

— Refunds, returns and withdrawal: EU consumer rules, our guarantee, and knowing when to say yes

— Disputes and chargebacks: PayPal and card cases, caught early enough to resolve instead of lose

— Comments and DMs under our ads: public, and often a cold audience's first impression of us

— Win-back conversations: the ones that turn a solved problem into another order



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---

We're not looking for someone who writes beautiful, polite
s and nothing else.

Anyone can do that now. AI made good prose free, which means good prose is no longer the job.

We're looking for someone who works the ticket before writing it. You should:

— Read the real carrier events, not the tracking link the customer already saw

— Check whether this person wrote before, and what was promised last time

— Notice the payment method — PayPal and card have different dispute clocks

— Tell a policy abuser apart from someone genuinely upset and about to leave one star

— Chase the courier yourself instead of telling the customer to keep waiting

— D
 within your limits instead of escalating everything and slowing the queue

— Close the conversation, so the same person doesn't write three more times

You should be able to take a Shopify order, a tracking page that hasn't moved in five days and an angry customer, and turn it into a resolved ticket and a customer who stays.



--- LANGUAGES (NON-NEGOTIABLE) ---

Our customers write from all over Europe, and every
 is answered in the language it arrived in — never in English, and never in something that reads like it came out of a translator. A customer can tell within one sentence.

— English at a top level, written and spoken. It's our working language and the one you translate through

— You don't need to be native in every market. You do need replies a native reader wouldn't flag as translated

— Which means catching what translation tools get wrong: formality in German, politeness register in French, warmth in Italian and Spanish

— Any European language you genuinely have is a strong plus, not a requirement

— Written level is what counts. You'll be judged on the
s you write, not on a certificate

If your English isn't strong enough to move quickly and accurately in both directions, this role isn't the right fit.



--- HOW WE USE AI (AND HOW WE DON'T) ---

We assume you use AI. Everyone does, and we'd be concerned if you didn't. What matters is how. You should be confident in:

— Drafting and translating with it, and holding one consistent tone across every language

— Building your own prompts, macros and saved replies, so the same answer isn't rewritten fifty times

— Checking every fact first: AI invents shipping dates and policies, and the customer holds us to them

— Knowing which tickets it never touches alone: reactions, legal threats, disputes, anyone on their third

— Spotting the answer that is technically correct and still wrong, because it missed the problem underneath

— Keeping the result human: a reply that reads as generated costs more trust than a slower one would have

If your workflow is pasting the customer's
 into ChatGPT and sending back whatever comes out, this role isn't the right fit.



--- THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---

You'll be a strong fit if you:

— Have handled real volume for an e-commerce brand, and know your daily ticket count

— Know your own numbers: response time, refund rate, chargeback rate, contact rate

— Are comfortable inside Shopify: orders, fulfillments, refunds, customer history

— Know what macros, tags and SLAs are actually for

— Chase people internally when something is stuck, without being asked twice

— Write short: six clear lines beat three paragraphs, in every language

— Stay calm with someone being unfair to you, and calm again the third time

— Have judgment about money: a partial refund today often beats a chargeback next week

— Notice patterns: thirty
s about one thing means something upstream is broken

— Care whether the customer comes back, not just whether the ticket is closed

We care about support that protects revenue. That doesn't mean saying no to customers. It means every reply — and every refund decision — should support the relationship, the trust, and the next order.



--- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ---

Ideally, you have experience with:

— Customer service for an e-commerce or DTC brand running paid social

— Shopify: orders, refunds, fulfillments, customer history

— A helpdesk: Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Front, Intercom, or similar

—
, WhatsApp, live chat, and Instagram and
 
 and comments

— Carrier tracking and claims, and dealing with couriers on missing parcels

— Refunds, returns and EU consumer rules, including the right of withdrawal

— PayPal and card disputes, resolved before they become chargebacks

— ChatGPT, Claude, DeepL, or an AI agent inside the helpdesk

Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY ---

— Answering
s in the language they arrived in, inside our response time targets

— Working each ticket properly: order, tracking, history and payment checked before you reply

— Chasing couriers on stuck parcels, and d
 when to reship

— Handling refunds, returns and withdrawal requests within your limits

— Catching disputes early, before they become chargebacks

— Replying to comments and DMs under our ads, where a cold audience is watching

— Improving macros, saved replies and prompts so the whole queue gets faster

— Flagging patterns: the product page that causes tickets, the courier that keeps failing

— Adapting tone and templates as each new European market opens



--- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU ---

— Competitive compensation based on experience

— Performance-based bonuses tied to real numbers: response time, satisfaction, refund rate

— Access to premium AI and support tools — fully covered by us

— Real autonomy: a spending limit you can d
 within, from early on

— Owning the customer relationship for a brand growing across multiple European markets

— Long-term growth with a fast-scaling D2C brand expanding internationally

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows that support is where trust is either built or lost — using both real judgment about customers and money, and the AI tools that make modern support possible at scale.

If you're a multilingual customer service specialist who works the ticket AND lives in the AI workflow, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Video Ads Editor — E-Commerce Performance Creative
description:
We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy, Spain and the UK, and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels — and who can do it with a modern, AI-first workflow: generating avatars, voices, scenes, characters and b-roll with AI, then cutting them into ads that feel real and convert. That's how we move fast, test more, and scale creative volume without sacrificing quality.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, AI-generated creative across every new format, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative for e-commerce.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING ---

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

—
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

— UGC-style ad creatives, both real and AI-generated: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

— AI talking-head and avatar ads: built with HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs and similar

— Animated and cartoon-style ads: 3D animated / Pixar-style characters, illustrated and stylized stories built entirely with AI

— Cinematic "mini-film" and drama ads: short scenes with AI actors, spoken dialogue and the product in the story

— AI music and song-based ads: lyrics, jingles and soundtracks generated with AI and cut to the beat

— Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

— Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

— VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

— Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

— Localized creatives for new European markets: AI dubbing, lip-sync and translated captions



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals.

We're looking for someone who understands how e-commerce ads work AND how to use AI to create them at scale.

You should know how to edit videos that:

— Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

— Make the problem feel real and urgent

— Show the product clearly and persuasively

— Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

— Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

— Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

— Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

— Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase on our Shopify store

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, AND AI-generated assets, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing.



--- AI WORKFLOW (NON-NEGOTIABLE) ---

This is the core of the role, not a bonus. You should be confident in:

— Generating UGC-style AI avatars and talking-head content (HeyGen, Higgsfield, or similar)

— Generating AI voiceovers and dubbing in multiple languages and tones, with lip-sync (ElevenLabs, HeyGen or similar)

— Generating AI video scenes from text and images: Kling, Veo, Seedance, Runway, Sora, Grok Imagine or similar

— Generating consistent AI images, characters and product shots to use as first frames and references (Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux or similar)

— Creating animated / cartoon / 3D-style characters that stay consistent from scene to scene

— Generating AI b-roll, supplementary visuals, and scene fillers when stock or original footage isn't enough

— Generating AI music and sound effects when the ad needs them (Suno, ElevenLabs or similar)

— Knowing which tool to use for which job — and combining them efficiently inside a single edit

— Optimizing tool credits and subscription costs: every generation has a real cost, and we need someone who gets the best output with the fewest wasted credits

— Iterating quickly when an AI generation doesn't land, without burning through resources

— Blending AI-generated content with real footage so the final ad feels native and believable, not artificial

New AI formats come out every month. We need someone who tries them first, not someone who waits for a tutorial.

If you've never touched these tools or you're not comfortable working in an AI-driven pipeline, this role isn't the right fit.



--- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---

You'll be a strong fit if you:

— Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands (beauty, skincare, or DTC is a strong plus)

— Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

— Have hands-on experience with AI generation tools (avatars, voice, video, images, music)

— Can show us AI-generated ads you made — not just tests, real ads that ran

— Can create multiple ad variations quickly

— Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

— Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

— Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

— Are resourceful with AI tools and credit budgets

— Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

— Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice — and every AI generation — should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



--- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ---

Ideally, you have experience with:

— Meta/Facebook ad creatives for e-commerce brands

— Short-form paid social videos

— Long-form VSLs or sales videos

— AI-generated UGC, avatar, animated, cinematic and b-roll content

— Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

— Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

— HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Kling, Veo, Seedance, Runway, Nano Banana, Midjourney, Suno, or similar AI platforms

Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY ---

— Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, AI-generated assets, and references

— Generating AI avatars, voiceovers, scenes, characters, b-roll and music as part of the production pipeline

— Producing new formats (animated, cinematic, song-based) alongside classic UGC and VSL ads

— Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

— Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

— Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios (Reels, Stories, Feed, TikTok)

— Building localized variations of winning ads for new European markets as we expand

— Managing AI tool usage efficiently to keep production costs under control

— Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

— Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



--- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU ---

— Competitive compensation based on experience

— Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

— Access to premium AI tools and platforms — fully covered by us

— The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive e-commerce revenue across multiple European markets

— Clear creative direction and fast feedback

— Long-term growth with a fast-scaling D2C brand expanding internationally

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert — using both classic direct-response editing instincts and the AI tools that make modern creative production possible at scale.

title: Self Managed Marketing, Automation, and Social Media Specialist (GoHighLevel, Meta Ads, ManyChat)
description:
Job Title: Self Managed Marketing, Automation, and Social Media Specialist (GoHighLevel, Meta Ads, ManyChat)



About Us



We’re a fast growing online business, and we need someone behind the scenes who we can lean on every day. I’m tired of managing people task by task. I want to hand this role an outcome and not think about it again until it’s done.



About the Role



You’ll own the systems and content that drive our marketing and lead flow: automations, campaigns, social media growth, video editing, and the day to day details that keep everything moving. This is not a task taker role. We need someone who sees what’s coming, spots problems early, and fixes them before we know they exist.



What You’ll Do



Build and manage workflows, pipelines, funnels, forms, and follow up sequences in GoHighLevel

Set up and monitor campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and tell us what’s working and what isn’t

Build and maintain ManyChat flows and connect them to our automations

Help grow our social media accounts by planning, scheduling, and posting consistently across [platforms, for example Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube]

Edit short form video for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts, including cuts, captions, hooks, and formatting

Repurpose long videos and existing content into multiple clips and posts

Watch what’s performing, tell us what to make more of, and bring us content ideas without being asked

Keep up with trends and flag the ones that fit our brand

Reply to comments and DMs when needed, in our voice

Use Claude and other AI tools daily to work faster and better

Test everything before it goes live and catch problems before our customers do

Think ahead. If a task will cause a problem down the road, raise it and fix it without being asked.

Notice what’s broken, outdated, or slowing us down, then bring a solution with the problem

Send a short end of day update: what’s done, what’s next, and what needs my attention



What We Need From You



Real, hands on experience with GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, and ManyChat

Strong automation logic: triggers, conditions, tags, and troubleshooting when something breaks

Daily, confident use of Claude or similar AI tools. We need someone who already works this way, not someone who’s open to learning it.

Proven experience growing or managing social media accounts. Show us examples with real results.

Video editing skills beyond the basics: pacing, captions, hooks, and clean exports, using CapCut or similar

A good eye for what stops the scroll, and the ability to explain why

A real understanding of content and marketing, meaning you know why something works

Sharp attention to detail

Strong critical thinking. If one approach isn’t working, you change course fast instead of sinking hours into it.

The ability to work without being managed. You figure it out, make a decision, and keep moving. When you need input, you bring your recommendation, not just a question.

Excellent written and spoken English

Fast, reliable communication during work hours

Stable internet, a reliable computer, and a quiet workspace



This Role Is Not for You If



You wait to be told what to do next

You need step by step instructions or regular check ins to stay on track

Tasks that should take 30 minutes turn into 2 or 3 hours

You go quiet when you get stuck

You’re still learning GoHighLevel, Meta Ads, or ManyChat

You’re not comfortable using AI as part of your daily workflow

You can’t commit to working hours that overlap with Colorado time



What We Offer



Full time, long term position with real room to grow

Pay: $800 per month base, plus a monthly performance bonus of $100 to $400 based on speed, quality, and results. Strong performers earn well above the base, and we raise pay for people who take ownership.

Paid twice a month through [payment method], on time, every time

Schedule: Full time, with at least 4 to 6 hours of overlap with Mountain Time (Colorado) every workday. This means working a US morning or afternoon schedule, which falls in the evening or overnight in the Philippines. You need to be reachable and responsive during that window.

Raises and added responsibility for people who take ownership

A chance to be part of a growing business with a global reach, working directly with the owner



How to Apply



Please read this carefully, because it’s the first test.



Start your message with the words “I move fast” so we know you read this.

Tell us which tools you’ve used (GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, ManyChat, Claude) and how long you’ve used each.

Give us one example of an automation or campaign you built, what it did, and the result.

Include links to 2 or 3 pieces of content you’ve edited or social accounts you’ve helped grow.

Tell us about a time you spotted a problem before anyone else did and what you did about it.

Tell us how you use AI in your work day to day, with specifics.

Send a short video (under 2 minutes) introducing yourself.

Confirm you can work during Colorado hours and tell us your availability and expected rate.



Applications that skip any of these steps won’t be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test task before we make a final decision.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Project Coordinator Remote, US Pacific Hours



We are a US electrical contractor hiring one Project Coordinator team member for a long-term seat. We are looking for a self-driven person with high goals who will give it 110%. For the right person this will be easy and rewarding. For the wrong person, you will hate it.



Please read the whole post. The application steps at the bottom are required. Applications that do not follow them will not be reviewed.



Quick Facts

• Department: Project Management. Reports to a Project Manager (Senior PM / GM CC'd as required).

• Remote, full-time

• Hours: 40 hours per week, during US Pacific Time business hours (this is a night shift in the Philippines). 

• Our PM team stays on Google Meet during business hours, like a virtual office.

• Start date: as soon as possible.



You Are a Good Fit If You

• Have at least 2 years of project coordination, project administration, or assistant PM experience in construction, electrical, or a related trade.

• Have personally prepared (not only supported) documents such as change orders, RFIs, submittals, Schedules of Values, or payment applications.

• Use Google Docs, Sheets, Drive, and Gmail every day. Contractor Foreman, QuickBooks, and supplier job accounts are a plus.

• Write clear, professional English. You will write weekly updates for PMs and general contractors.

• Have reliable internet, backup power, and a quiet workspace for Pacific Time hours.

• Want a long-term career and looking to grow with us.



This Is Not a Fit If You

• Want an engineering, design or admin assistant role, or see this as a short-term stop. This is a support seat that grows into project management through performance.

• Have no project, construction, or coordination experience beyond general admin, bookkeeping, or customer service.

• Cannot work Pacific Time hours.

• Need to be told every step. We want people who take ownership.

• List tools or skills on your resume that you cannot explain. We will ask you to walk us through real examples of everything you claim



What You Will Do

Project setup

• Create job folders in Google Drive when a contract is awarded.

• Distribute startup documents: certificates of insurance, business licenses, Joint Check Agreements, and team introduction letters.

• Set up job accounts with material vendors (such as Platt).

• Help PMs with job costing worksheets and prepare Schedules of Values in Google Sheets and Contractor Foreman.

• Track submittals.



Tracking and weekly updates

• Track schedules, daily site reports, and site photos by job phase and date.

• Route incoming job
s and critical requests to the PM.

• Prepare the Weekly Job Team Talk (WJTT) for every active job, every week: progress, schedule, labor hours, materials and deliveries, risks, and next steps.



Contractor Foreman

• Load jobs, plans, and documents; make sure daily logs are completed; set up field team members and check their access.

• Keep jobs current and clean through closeout, including month-end percent-complete updates.



Materials and equipment

• Order and coordinate materials and equipment within approved budgets.

• Track deliveries, equipment rentals, and tooling lists.

• Help Purchasing with large orders, pricing, and follow-ups.

• Coordinate lodging, per diem, and mileage tracking for the field team.



Change orders and billing support

• Prepare change orders for T&M, scope changes, overtime, and equipment-driven work, and track each one from first call to invoice.

• Assist with retainage, invoicing, collections, and monthly progress billings (manager approval required).

• Review and process payment applications.



Team RRE Core Values

• We are team players.

• We prioritize open communication.

• We exercise emotional control.

• We do the right thing.

• We are dedicated to winning.



What's in It for You

• A strong, winning team culture.

• A permanent, full-time position with real growth into project management and senior leadership as we expand.

• Six paid holidays per year and paid sick leave, both starting after the 90-day probation period.



How to Apply (Required)

1.  Use the subject line: PC/PM – Your Full Name.

2.  Include a shareable Google Drive link to your resume, set to "Anyone with the link can view." Links that are private, expired, or ask for access will not be reviewed.

title: IT Certification Instructor & Live Mentor
description:
# IT Live Mentoring Instructor – Responsibilities & Qualifications



**Position:** Part-Time, Remote (Philippines-Based)  

**Schedule:** Mondays and Wednesdays, 7:30 PM – 10:00 PM US Eastern Time  

**Hours:** 5 scheduled hours per week, plus occasional additional student support as needed  

**Company:** 
 LLC



## Job Responsibilities



- Conduct virtual Live Mentoring sessions every Monday and Wednesday from 7:30 PM to 10:00 PM US Eastern Time.

- Remain logged into the virtual mentoring platform, attentive, available, and engaged throughout each scheduled session, with the camera on except when screen sharing or otherwise authorized. Maintain a professional appearance and distraction-free working environment.

- Provide instructional and technical support across all MedCertify IT programs, including HelpDesk IT Support Technician, Information Technology Specialist, Cyber Security Professional, CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, CySA+, PenTest+, and Cloud+, as well as any additional IT programs introduced by MedCertify.

- Answer student questions, clarify course concepts, and provide supplemental instruction to reinforce understanding and support certification preparation.

- Use screen sharing to demonstrate technical processes, troubleshoot issues, and explain concepts through practical examples.

- Deliver short lessons, technical demonstrations, or instructional walkthroughs based on student needs.

- Research unfamiliar technical questions when necessary and provide accurate, timely instructional guidance.

- Occasionally respond to
s from Student Services regarding students requiring additional instructional support or planning to attend a specific Live Mentoring session for assistance with a particular topic.

- When requested by Student Services, provide written instructional guidance for student questions requiring instructor expertise.

- In rare escalated situations, coordinate with Student Services to schedule a brief one-on-one virtual support session for students unable to attend regular mentoring.

- Communicate with Student Services regarding instructional concerns or additional student support needs.

- Follow the provided Live Mentoring calendar, excluding designated federal holidays and specified days preceding holidays.

- Provide occasional additional student support outside scheduled mentoring hours when coordinated in advance, with additional time compensated separately.



## Required Qualifications



- Professional experience in IT support, networking, cybersecurity, systems administration, or related fields.

- Broad technical knowledge across IT support, networking, cybersecurity, and cloud computing, with the ability to research and effectively address student questions across MedCertify's IT certification programs.

- Relevant IT certifications or equivalent demonstrated expertise, such as:

  - CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Cloud+

  - Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)

  - Microsoft MCSE, MCSA, MCDST, or MCITP

- Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to students with varying levels of experience.

- Strong troubleshooting skills and experience demonstrating technical processes.

- Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.

- Proficiency with virtual meeting platforms, screen sharing, and remote instruction.

- Reliable availability during scheduled mentoring sessions, including US daylight saving time adjustments.



## Remote Work Requirements



- Reliable high-speed internet capable of supporting uninterrupted video conferencing and screen sharing.

- Computer with sufficient processing power and memory to demonstrate IT concepts and troubleshooting procedures.

- Working webcam, microphone, and headset.

- Quiet, professional workspace suitable for live student instruction.

- Backup internet connectivity preferred.

- Ability to maintain the required US Eastern Time schedule throughout the year. Sessions generally occur Tuesday and Thursday mornings in the Philippines, with local start times changing according to US daylight saving time.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Previous experience as an IT instructor, technical trainer, or certification mentor.

- Experience preparing students for CompTIA certification examinations.

- Additional certifications in networking, cybersecurity, or cloud computing.

- Experience supporting adult learners in virtual learning environments.

- Experience providing technical instruction to US-based students.



## Candidate Evaluation



Qualified candidates may be required to complete a 15–20-minute live virtual technical demonstration on a selected IT topic. The evaluation will assess technical knowledge, instructional ability, spoken English proficiency, troubleshooting skills, and effective use of screen sharing.

title: Content Strategist/Social Media Manager
description:
We are hiring a Content Strategist / Social Media Manager to plan, produce, and execute content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok for an established personal brand in the video marketing and monetization space.



This is a hybrid role. You will own the content planning process — building monthly plans, writing hooks, scripting videos, and tracking trends — AND you will execute that plan day to day: scheduling, publishing, managing the content calendar, and monitoring performance. 



Content direction and final approval come from Keenya, but you are the person who turns her vision into a running system that never misses a beat.



You will have room to bring your own instincts to formatting, execution, and idea generation.



But this is not a role where you are setting the brand's overall strategic direction from scratch. 



The win here is doing excellent work inside a clear system: planning with precision, executing with speed, and speaking up when something is working or when it is not.



About the Brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income. 



We are a systems-driven team that moves fast, especially during launch periods, and we need someone who can keep pace without needing constant hand-holding.



What This Role Actually Is



You are the engine that keeps content moving every day — from the planning stage all the way through to publishing. You will build the content plans, write the hooks and captions, track what is trending, and then bring all of that to life across platforms on schedule. 



You bring enough of your own judgment to catch what is working, flag what is not, and suggest adjustments in real time.



We are not looking for someone who only follows instructions with no instincts of their own. 



We want someone with a genuine feel for short vertical video who can plan strategically, execute at a high level, and speak up when something is not landing.



What We Are Looking For



1. You can plan content that actually drives results

You build monthly content plans that include filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations for TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn. 



Every piece aligns with our content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals so each video moves people toward a clear next step.



2. You have a real feel for short vertical video

You understand pacing, hooks, text overlay timing, and what makes a piece of content stop the scroll. 



You track current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turn them into content ideas that fit our brand — not just follow trends blindly.



3. You can execute at volume, reliably

You manage content calendars, schedule and publish across multiple platforms, and keep everything organized without things falling through the cracks — especially during launch periods when volume increases. 



You keep a clean, organized tracker so the team always knows what is approved, filmed, and scheduled.



4. You write hooks that stop the scroll and captions that sound human

You write on-screen text hooks that make people stop scrolling. Your captions feel like a real conversation, not a sales pitch. 



You have a natural sense of voice and can write in a style that sounds like the person posting — not like generic marketing copy.



5. You are proactive, not just responsive

You flag what is underperforming, suggest small tweaks, and bring ideas to the table — without needing to own the entire strategic direction. 



You know the difference between "I have a suggestion" and "I am going to change the plan."



6. You are highly organized and communicative

You meet deadlines without being chased, you do not go quiet when things get busy, and you are comfortable working inside an established system with clear processes. 



You submit plans on a set schedule and revise them quickly based on feedback.



7. You are comfortable working under direction from the brand owner

This role reports into content direction set by Keenya. You should want that structure, not resent it. 



You take direction well and give thoughtful input without needing to own every decision.



What This Role Involves



Planning

Building monthly content plans with filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations

Tracking current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turning them into on-brand content ideas

Aligning every piece with content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals

Submitting plans on a set schedule and revising quickly based on feedback

Execution

Publishing and scheduling content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok

Managing and maintaining the content calendar

Executing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs as directed, with room for your own polish on formatting and delivery

Keeping content organized in our shared systems (Google Workspace, ManyChat, Metricool)

Performance and Communication

Monitoring performance day to day and flagging what is working or not

Adapting quickly and staying responsive during active launches, live challenges, webinars, and campaigns

Communicating proactively — daily check-ins during active periods



You Are the Right Fit If...



You have real experience both planning and executing content at volume across multiple platforms

You understand short vertical video and can write strong hooks, plan pacing, and direct text overlays

You have a track record of creating content that drives engagement and turns into sales

You are highly organized and reliable with deadlines

You communicate proactively and do not disappear when things get busy

You are comfortable executing someone else's strategic direction while still bringing your own instincts to the work

You have strong written communication and a natural sense of voice

You have experience with spreadsheets, project trackers, and content management tools

You have a warm, collaborative personality — you will be part of a small team that works hard and has fun doing it



This Is Not the Right Role If...



You want to set the overall brand strategy yourself

You need full creative ownership over every decision

You struggle with deadlines, communication, or structured systems

You are only comfortable posting content, without any instinct for what is actually working

You are only comfortable planning content, without the ability to manage day-to-day publishing



Nice to Have



Experience in creator education, coaching, or marketing for women entrepreneurs

Familiarity with
 funnels and launch sequences



How to Apply



Start your application message with the word TIKTOK to confirm you have read the full posting.



Then answer the screening questions below and attach your resume and two or three examples of content you have planned or created that performed well, with results if you have them.



Your application should also include:



A brief note on your experience executing content across TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn — what platforms, what volume, what tools you have used

One or two examples of accounts where you handled both planning and execution — what your role was specifically, and what the results looked like

Your availability for a full-time role



Applications that are vague or do not include specifics on your actual planning and execution experience will not be reviewed.



Screening Questions



Walk us through a piece of content you planned that turned into sales. What was the hook, the format, the CTA, and the result?

Which TikTok or Instagram trend are you watching right now? Explain why it is working and how you would adapt it for women business owners.

Write a sample on-screen text hook (one line) for a video about why women business owners should stop waiting to feel ready before they start filming. Then give a second hook that uses a contrarian angle.



Our plans are due on a set day each month. Describe a time you met a tight deadline while keeping quality high. How did you prioritize?

How do you keep a content calendar organized when you are managing many pieces at once? What tools or systems do you use?

How do you make sure captions sound like the person who is posting them and not like generic marketing copy?

Tell us about a time you received feedback that changed your approach. How did you respond?

What does a healthy working relationship with a content owner look like to you, and how do you handle it when your ideas are not chosen?

Our team is small and works closely together. What do you enjoy most about collaborating on a creative team?

What is your availability each week, and what time zone are you working in?

title: Technical Apparel Designer
description:
About the role:



Rapid Hockey is looking for a freelance technical apparel designer to build the patterns, 3D samples, and tech packs behind our custom team uniforms. This is an ongoing, project-based role: each time we develop a new style, you'll be our first call.



Rapid Hockey (also known as Rapid Athletic) makes fully custom hockey uniforms, including jerseys, socks, and related apparel, for teams and programs. We're building out our product documentation so any qualified factory can produce our garments to the same standard. Your work will become the master blueprint for every style we make.



What you'll do:



You'll take each style from concept or existing sample to a factory-ready package.

1. Pattern making. Create production patterns for new styles, and reverse engineer patterns from our existing garments where we don't have files. Grade patterns across our full youth through adult size range.

2. 3D development in CLO 3D. Build each style as a 3D garment to check fit, proportions, and decoration placement before we cut a physical sample.

3. Tech packs. Produce complete tech packs for each base style: bill of materials, fabric and trim specs, construction and stitching details, graded measurement charts, and decoration specs for sublimation and tackle twill.

4. Factory handoff support. Answer factory questions, review samples against spec, and update files when we make changes.



To start, we'll document our two or three best-selling styles out of about 10 base styles, then work through the rest over time.



What we're looking for:

Required

• 3+ years of technical design or pattern making experience in apparel

• Strong working knowledge of CLO 3D, with a portfolio showing 3D garments you built

• Experience creating full tech packs that factories have produced from

• Pattern grading across a wide size range

• Ability to reverse engineer patterns and specs from finished garments

• Clear written English and reliable communication across time zones

Nice to have

• Experience with team sports or athletic uniforms, especially hockey jerseys and socks

• Knowledge of sublimation, tackle twill, and performance knit fabrics

• Experience working directly with overseas factories

• Familiarity with Techpacker or similar tech pack software



Engagement and how to apply:

• Type: Freelance, ongoing, project-based

• Location: Remote

• Pay: $6/hour

• Ownership: All patterns, CLO files, and tech packs created are owned by Rapid Hockey and delivered in editable source formats



To apply, send:

1. Your portfolio, including at least one CLO 3D garment and one complete tech pack

2. Confirmation that $6/hour works for you, and your typical hours per style

3. A short note on any team sports or athletic apparel you've worked on

title: Email Support Expert — Shopify DTC brand
description:
We're looking for a customer service specialist who understands one thing clearly:

A good reply doesn't just sound polite. It answers the real question, solves the problem before it grows, and turns a frustrated customer into one who orders again.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy, Spain, UK and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means most customers meet us through an ad, arrive with questions, and write to us in their own language. Support is not a cost center for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of trust, retention, and repeat revenue.

We're looking for someone who can own that inbox across several languages — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us answer fast, absorb volume, and open new markets without the quality dropping.

This role is ideal for someone who understands e-commerce support, multilingual communication, courier problems, refunds and disputes, AI-assisted workflows, and the difference between closing a ticket and keeping a customer.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE HANDLING ---

You'll be working the inbox of a DTC brand running paid traffic, which means:

— "Where is my order": stalled tracking, parcels stuck at a hub, deliveries marked complete but never received

— Pre-purchase questions: people who saw the ad and want to know if it works and if we're real

— Product and skin questions: ingredients, how to use it, what to expect and when, sensitive skin, pregnancy

— Reactions and complaints: rare, serious, handled carefully and escalated properly

— Refunds, returns and withdrawal: EU consumer rules, our guarantee, and knowing when to say yes

— Disputes and chargebacks: PayPal and card cases, caught early enough to resolve instead of lose

— Comments and DMs under our ads: public, and often a cold audience's first impression of us

— Win-back conversations: the ones that turn a solved problem into another order



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---

We're not looking for someone who writes beautiful, polite
s and nothing else.

Anyone can do that now. AI made good prose free, which means good prose is no longer the job.

We're looking for someone who works the ticket before writing it. You should:

— Read the real carrier events, not the tracking link the customer already saw

— Check whether this person wrote before, and what was promised last time

— Notice the payment method — PayPal and card have different dispute clocks

— Tell a policy abuser apart from someone genuinely upset and about to leave one star

— Chase the courier yourself instead of telling the customer to keep waiting

— D
 within your limits instead of escalating everything and slowing the queue

— Close the conversation, so the same person doesn't write three more times

You should be able to take a Shopify order, a tracking page that hasn't moved in five days and an angry customer, and turn it into a resolved ticket and a customer who stays.



--- LANGUAGES (NON-NEGOTIABLE) ---

Our customers write from all over Europe, and every
 is answered in the language it arrived in — never in English, and never in something that reads like it came out of a translator. A customer can tell within one sentence.

— English at a top level, written and spoken. It's our working language and the one you translate through

— You don't need to be native in every market. You do need replies a native reader wouldn't flag as translated

— Which means catching what translation tools get wrong: formality in German, politeness register in French, warmth in Italian and Spanish

— Any European language you genuinely have is a strong plus, not a requirement

— Written level is what counts. You'll be judged on the
s you write, not on a certificate

If your English isn't strong enough to move quickly and accurately in both directions, this role isn't the right fit.



--- HOW WE USE AI (AND HOW WE DON'T) ---

We assume you use AI. Everyone does, and we'd be concerned if you didn't. What matters is how. You should be confident in:

— Drafting and translating with it, and holding one consistent tone across every language

— Building your own prompts, macros and saved replies, so the same answer isn't rewritten fifty times

— Checking every fact first: AI invents shipping dates and policies, and the customer holds us to them

— Knowing which tickets it never touches alone: reactions, legal threats, disputes, anyone on their third

— Spotting the answer that is technically correct and still wrong, because it missed the problem underneath

— Keeping the result human: a reply that reads as generated costs more trust than a slower one would have

If your workflow is pasting the customer's
 into ChatGPT and sending back whatever comes out, this role isn't the right fit.



--- THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---

You'll be a strong fit if you:

— Have handled real volume for an e-commerce brand, and know your daily ticket count

— Know your own numbers: response time, refund rate, chargeback rate, contact rate

— Are comfortable inside Shopify: orders, fulfillments, refunds, customer history

— Know what macros, tags and SLAs are actually for

— Chase people internally when something is stuck, without being asked twice

— Write short: six clear lines beat three paragraphs, in every language

— Stay calm with someone being unfair to you, and calm again the third time

— Have judgment about money: a partial refund today often beats a chargeback next week

— Notice patterns: thirty
s about one thing means something upstream is broken

— Care whether the customer comes back, not just whether the ticket is closed

We care about support that protects revenue. That doesn't mean saying no to customers. It means every reply — and every refund decision — should support the relationship, the trust, and the next order.



--- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ---

Ideally, you have experience with:

— Customer service for an e-commerce or DTC brand running paid social

— Shopify: orders, refunds, fulfillments, customer history

— A helpdesk: Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Front, Intercom, or similar

—
, WhatsApp, live chat, and Instagram and
 
 and comments

— Carrier tracking and claims, and dealing with couriers on missing parcels

— Refunds, returns and EU consumer rules, including the right of withdrawal

— PayPal and card disputes, resolved before they become chargebacks

— ChatGPT, Claude, DeepL, or an AI agent inside the helpdesk

Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY ---

— Answering
s in the language they arrived in, inside our response time targets

— Working each ticket properly: order, tracking, history and payment checked before you reply

— Chasing couriers on stuck parcels, and d
 when to reship

— Handling refunds, returns and withdrawal requests within your limits

— Catching disputes early, before they become chargebacks

— Replying to comments and DMs under our ads, where a cold audience is watching

— Improving macros, saved replies and prompts so the whole queue gets faster

— Flagging patterns: the product page that causes tickets, the courier that keeps failing

— Adapting tone and templates as each new European market opens



--- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU ---

— Competitive compensation based on experience

— Performance-based bonuses tied to real numbers: response time, satisfaction, refund rate

— Access to premium AI and support tools — fully covered by us

— Real autonomy: a spending limit you can d
 within, from early on

— Owning the customer relationship for a brand growing across multiple European markets

— Long-term growth with a fast-scaling D2C brand expanding internationally

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows that support is where trust is either built or lost — using both real judgment about customers and money, and the AI tools that make modern support possible at scale.

If you're a multilingual customer service specialist who works the ticket AND lives in the AI workflow, we'd love to hear from you.



--- READY TO APPLY? ---

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Video Ads Editor — E-Commerce Performance Creative
description:
We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy, Spain and the UK, and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels — and who can do it with a modern, AI-first workflow: generating avatars, voices, scenes, characters and b-roll with AI, then cutting them into ads that feel real and convert. That's how we move fast, test more, and scale creative volume without sacrificing quality.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, AI-generated creative across every new format, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative for e-commerce.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING ---

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

—
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

— UGC-style ad creatives, both real and AI-generated: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

— AI talking-head and avatar ads: built with HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs and similar

— Animated and cartoon-style ads: 3D animated / Pixar-style characters, illustrated and stylized stories built entirely with AI

— Cinematic "mini-film" and drama ads: short scenes with AI actors, spoken dialogue and the product in the story

— AI music and song-based ads: lyrics, jingles and soundtracks generated with AI and cut to the beat

— Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

— Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

— VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

— Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

— Localized creatives for new European markets: AI dubbing, lip-sync and translated captions



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals.

We're looking for someone who understands how e-commerce ads work AND how to use AI to create them at scale.

You should know how to edit videos that:

— Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

— Make the problem feel real and urgent

— Show the product clearly and persuasively

— Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

— Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

— Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

— Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

— Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase on our Shopify store

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, AND AI-generated assets, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing.



--- AI WORKFLOW (NON-NEGOTIABLE) ---

This is the core of the role, not a bonus. You should be confident in:

— Generating UGC-style AI avatars and talking-head content (HeyGen, Higgsfield, or similar)

— Generating AI voiceovers and dubbing in multiple languages and tones, with lip-sync (ElevenLabs, HeyGen or similar)

— Generating AI video scenes from text and images: Kling, Veo, Seedance, Runway, Sora, Grok Imagine or similar

— Generating consistent AI images, characters and product shots to use as first frames and references (Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux or similar)

— Creating animated / cartoon / 3D-style characters that stay consistent from scene to scene

— Generating AI b-roll, supplementary visuals, and scene fillers when stock or original footage isn't enough

— Generating AI music and sound effects when the ad needs them (Suno, ElevenLabs or similar)

— Knowing which tool to use for which job — and combining them efficiently inside a single edit

— Optimizing tool credits and subscription costs: every generation has a real cost, and we need someone who gets the best output with the fewest wasted credits

— Iterating quickly when an AI generation doesn't land, without burning through resources

— Blending AI-generated content with real footage so the final ad feels native and believable, not artificial

New AI formats come out every month. We need someone who tries them first, not someone who waits for a tutorial.

If you've never touched these tools or you're not comfortable working in an AI-driven pipeline, this role isn't the right fit.



--- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---

You'll be a strong fit if you:

— Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands (beauty, skincare, or DTC is a strong plus)

— Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

— Have hands-on experience with AI generation tools (avatars, voice, video, images, music)

— Can show us AI-generated ads you made — not just tests, real ads that ran

— Can create multiple ad variations quickly

— Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

— Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

— Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

— Are resourceful with AI tools and credit budgets

— Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

— Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice — and every AI generation — should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



--- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ---

Ideally, you have experience with:

— Meta/Facebook ad creatives for e-commerce brands

— Short-form paid social videos

— Long-form VSLs or sales videos

— AI-generated UGC, avatar, animated, cinematic and b-roll content

— Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

— Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

— HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Kling, Veo, Seedance, Runway, Nano Banana, Midjourney, Suno, or similar AI platforms

Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY ---

— Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, AI-generated assets, and references

— Generating AI avatars, voiceovers, scenes, characters, b-roll and music as part of the production pipeline

— Producing new formats (animated, cinematic, song-based) alongside classic UGC and VSL ads

— Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

— Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

— Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios (Reels, Stories, Feed, TikTok)

— Building localized variations of winning ads for new European markets as we expand

— Managing AI tool usage efficiently to keep production costs under control

— Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

— Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



--- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU ---

— Competitive compensation based on experience

— Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

— Access to premium AI tools and platforms — fully covered by us

— The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive e-commerce revenue across multiple European markets

— Clear creative direction and fast feedback

— Long-term growth with a fast-scaling D2C brand expanding internationally

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert — using both classic direct-response editing instincts and the AI tools that make modern creative production possible at scale.

If you're an e-commerce ad video editor who understands performance creative AND lives in the AI workflow, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor and Social Media Manager
description:
Salt Lake Express is looking for someone to help run our creator partnerships and social media.



You’ll work with our marketing director to find and contact creators and coordinate with them to get videos we can edit and turn into social media content. 



What you’ll do

- Find and message creators. Look for people whose audiences could use our bus service. Write personal messages, answer questions, and follow up.

- Coordinate trips. Help creators choose a trip. Work with reservations and dispatch to arrange travel and confirm the bus, pickup location, and departure time.

- Keep records current. Update our partnership spreadsheet with contact details, agreed terms, promo codes, content, and payment status.

- Collect and edit content. Give each creator a shared folder. Collect their videos and photos. Turn them into short videos, Stories, and posts with clear captions.

- Publish content. Get approval on edits, schedule posts, and coordinate shared posts with creators.

- Make sure creators get paid. Confirm that required posts are live. Prepare the monthly payment spreadsheet, send it to accounting after approval, and follow up until payment is complete.



What a typical partnership looks like



A student athlete agrees to make a video about a trip to Las Vegas. You help arrange the trip, confirm the pickup details, and send their promo code. After the trip, you collect their footage, edit the video, coordinate the post, and make sure their payment is included in the monthly spreadsheet.



You’re a good fit if you

- Have edited many social media videos into engaging content - This is a core skill of the position. Both from a taste perspective and technical ability. You must be able to d
 which clips to use, what to cut, and combine them in a way that makes a nice video. If you dont have any experience with this, do not apply. 

- Write friendly messages that sound like a person.

- Stay organized and follow through without reminders.

- Know how to post and schedule content on Instagram and
.

- Are comfortable with Google Drive and spreadsheets.

- Ask questions when details are unclear and catch mistakes before they become problems.



Experience with creator partnerships is helpful. Strong taste for good videos and editing skills is a must. 



To apply



Send a short introduction and two or three examples of videos or social posts you’ve made. Tell us which parts you handled and your availability.

title: E-commerce Designer (Etsy + Shopify + Short-Form Video) | Full-Time | US Pacific Hours
description:
A growing US-based custom apparel and promotional merchandise brand is looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented Designer who takes ownership and gets things done.



This isn't just a graphic design role. You'll take charge of the brand's two Etsy shops and Shopify website, creating professional product listings, polished graphics, compelling product mockups, and engaging short-form videos that help products stand out and attract customers.



We're looking for someone who can think independently, anticipate what customers need, and turn ideas into finished work that's ready to publish. You should have a strong eye for detail, take pride in the quality of your output, and catch mistakes before anyone else has to point them out.



This is a long-term, full-time opportunity through Jarvis, a US-based agency connecting top Filipino Specialists with US business owners. We value initiative, accountability, and people who take ownership of their results.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



- Manage and optimize two Etsy shops: Create and improve product listings with professional product photos, realistic mockups, size-comparison images, compelling descriptions, and consistent formatting.

- Create high-quality designs: Develop graphics, product visuals, and mockups using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.

- Maintain the Shopify website: Upload and organize products, manage categories, and keep the website accurate, consistent, and up to date without needing step-by-step instructions.

- Edit short-form videos: Produce engaging Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts, highlighting the most important product features right from the start.

- Take initiative: Identify design inconsistencies, listing errors, and website issues, then resolve them before they become problems.

- Maintain quality standards: Review your own work before submission. Everything should be polished, accurate, and ready for publishing.



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

All five requirements are mandatory:

- Hands-on Etsy experience: You must have personally created and managed Etsy product listings. Provide live links to listings you've worked on.

- Advanced Photoshop and Illustrator skills: You can independently create professional graphics, product mockups, and marketing visuals.

- Shopify or website development experience: You understand product uploads, website organization, categories, and basic site management.

- Short-form video editing experience: You have edited Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts and can provide actual work samples.

- Detail-oriented and self-checking: No typos, sloppy spacing, or wordy copy. Delivers clean, accurate, polished, publication-ready work without needing someone else to proofread or correct it.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF...

- You need step-by-step instructions for every assignment.

- You regularly submit unfinished work or expect someone else to catch your mistakes.

- You struggle to work independently or take initiative.

- Your portfolio consists mainly of templates, stock designs, or AI-generated work rather than projects you've personally created.

- You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality.



WORK REQUIREMENTS

- Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day during US Pacific business hours.

- Backup power: Must have a UPS, generator, or power station capable of keeping both your computer and internet router running during power interruptions.

- Internet: Minimum 50 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload speed. Fiber connection preferred. A recent speed test screenshot is required.

- Time tracking: Hubstaff must be running during all working hours.

- Skills assessment: Candidates who pass the initial screening will complete a short skills test involving rewriting and improving an Etsy listing using a sample product.



HOW TO APPLY



Ready to take ownership of an e-commerce brand's creative operations?



Complete your application here:







Please have the following ready:

- Links to Etsy product listings you've personally created.

- Your graphic design portfolio featuring Photoshop and Illustrator work.

- At least one short-form video you've personally edited.

- A recent internet speed test screenshot.



Important: We do not accept resumes or applications through OLJ messages. Only applicants who complete the official pre-screening application will be considered.



We're looking for a specialist who doesn't just complete tasks but takes pride in delivering excellent work, solves problems independently, and makes things happen.
